content.description:
Mobile full-screen subscription / paywall modal with a bright, friendly visual language. Overall canvas: full-bleed white background (#FFFFFF) with vertically stacked sections centered horizontally. Top area: small top status / safe-area spacing (~24–32 px) then a colorful illustrative hero (three stylized beverage containers in yellow #E4CB07, purple #6730E6 and pink #B53D59) centered horizontally. Below the illustration is a short green subheading with a check icon reading “Track 40+ beverages” (accent green #2BCAEE used for icon/text highlights) then the main headline “Become a hydration hero!” in a large bold dark type (#3F3429).

Pricing options block: two rounded rectangular cards stacked vertically with generous horizontal padding and large border radii (approx. 20–28 px). The top card is a light aqua pill with a pale cyan background (very light tint of #2BCAEE; use #E6FBFF or #DFF8FB) containing the one-time lifetime offer headline “Lifetime, Pay once” in bold cyan (#2BCAEE) with struck-through original price in red/muted pink (#B53D59) and the sale price in dark text (#3F3429). A pill-style magenta ribbon badge (rounded rectangular tab) overlaps the top-right corner of this card with white label text “-57% ENDS SOON” (badge color #B53D59).

The selected option card sits below with a vibrant cyan/turquoise background (primary cyan #2BCAEE used as the fill). This card uses white headline text “0.00€ due now” in bold (large size) and secondary dark text (near #3F3429) describing the trial and annual price. The left side of the card shows a small circular selection indicator — a white circular check icon inside a thin cyan ring — partially overlapping the card margin. The card contains a three-line checklist with check icons (white or light) and short lines of text. Card corners are fully rounded (~22–26 px). Add subtle inner shadow or drop shadow (rgba(45,45,45,0.08), 0px 6px 20px) to lift cards from background.

Primary CTA: a large full-width pill button with heavy weight, dark navy fill (#3F3429) and white centered label “Start my 3-day Free trial”. Button height ~60–70 px, border-radius ~36 px, horizontal padding 24–32 px; text size ~18–20 px semibold. The button is separated from cards with ~28–36 px vertical spacing.

Trust / award area: below CTA, a horizontal row containing left-aligned stacked partner logos (grayscale, low opacity), a central circular gold medal illustration (use yellow #E4CB07 and gold gradients: #F6D65B to #E4CB07) labeled “APPLE DESIGN AWARD” with laurel and small Apple glyph, and to the right a rating block showing “250,000+” and 5 yellow stars. This row visually reads as a 3-column layout on one horizontal line (left logos column, center medal, right rating). Spacing between columns is generous and contents are vertically centered.

Close control: small floating circular close button at the top-right within safe area. White circular background with subtle shadow and a dark X icon (#3F3429). Diameter approx. 44 px with 8–10 px inner padding. Status bar area is visible at very top.

Typography: use a geometric neo-grotesque similar to SF Pro Display or Inter. Suggested scales: Heading (H1) 28–34 px, semibold/700; Subheading 16–18 px medium/600; Body 14–16 px regular/400; Small / microcopy 12–13 px regular. Line-height approx 1.25–1.45. Text alignment is predominantly center for hero and headings, left-aligned inside cards for legibility, and center for the CTA.

Colors (main used): cyan/turquoise #2BCAEE for primary accents and selected card; gold #E4CB07 for medal and small accents; dark brown/ink #3F3429 for primary headings and CTA background; magenta/pink #B53D59 for sale ribbon and strike price tint; purple #6730E6 used in the hero illustration. Secondary greys: #6B7280 for secondary copy, and pale aqua #E9FBFD for the top offer card background. Use white (#FFFFFF) for card text on cyan and for CTA text.

Micro-interactions / animation notes: card selection should animate with a 160–220ms ease-out scale/raise (elevation and subtle scale to 1.02). Badge slide-in animation from the right over 300ms with ease-out. CTA press state: subtle downward 60ms transform and darker background. Close button fade/scale in ~180ms.

Spacing & layout metrics (approx for a 375 px wide mobile artboard): Left/right outer padding 20 px; hero to heading gap 12 px; heading to cards gap 20–28 px; cards horizontal inset 20 px, vertical stack gap 14–18 px; CTA full-width inset 20 px and top margin from last card 24–32 px; trust row vertical margin 24 px; bottom safe area 24–36 px. All cards and CTA are centered within a single-column layout.
content.layout:
Single-column mobile layout with vertically stacked groups. Top safe-area plus hero illustration and two centered headings form the header group. Pricing group contains two stacked card components (card 1 = light aqua lifetime offer; card 2 = selected turquoise trial offer) — these form a single-column group with internal left-aligned content. CTA group is one full-width pill button centered and occupying most horizontal space. Trust row beneath CTA is a three-column horizontal row: left column = stacked partner logos (vertical stack), center column = circular medal illustration, right column = numeric rating plus star row. Footer follows with small headline and more content (not fully visible in the screenshot).

Columns and groups: 1 main column overall. Within the trust row: 3 columns (logos / medal / rating). Pricing block internally uses 1 column but visually shows two card 'tiles' stacked. No complex grid elsewhere.

Visual hierarchy keywords: centered hero; stacked cards; full-width CTA; floating close control; horizontally distributed trust row; overlapped badge element on card; circular selection indicator overlapping card margin.
content.functions:
Specific actions available on this screen:
- Tap the circular X (top-right) to dismiss the modal and return to the previous context. Visual feedback: button depress animation and close action.
- Inspect plan details: read the headline, price, strike-through former price, and the small-print copy inside each pricing card.
- Switch/select a pricing option: tap a pricing card or the circular check control to mark it as selected. Visual feedback: card gains accent color, selection check appears; subtle elevation animation.
- Read checklist items inside a pricing option (three bullet lines with check icons) and tap the small link “See how” to view more details about cancellation or trial specifics (likely opens a detail screen or inline modal).
- Tap the large CTA “Start my 3-day Free trial” to initiate the trial flow and begin the subscription/purchase process (this triggers authentication/billing flows or a system purchase sheet). Visual feedback: button pressed state, progress to next screen.
- View trust signals: glance partner logos, award medal and star ratings to assess app credibility.
- Scroll: the content is vertically scrollable to reveal additional trust copy or terms below.

Medium-level workflows:
- Compare offers: user can evaluate the lifetime one-time purchase vs the free trial annual subscription by reading both cards and the highlighted pricing.
- Choose plan and start purchase: select option, then tap CTA to begin purchase/checkout flow, optionally tapping links for more details before confirming.
- Discover cancellation and trial date info: read microcopy showing trial end date and cancellation policy; use “Remind me” or “See how” links to configure notifications or see instructions.

Broader purpose achieved by this screen:
- Convert free users into paying customers by clearly presenting product value (hero + benefits), two pricing options (one-time lifetime vs free trial to subscription), highlighting urgency (percentage-off badge) and social proof (awards/logos/ratings), and giving a single clear CTA. The screen reduces friction by clearly showing ‘0.00€ due now’ for the trial and making the selection and action obvious, while reinforcing trust via badges and awards.

content.description:
Overall style and goal
- Clean, modern mobile promotional screen designed for a vertical scroll. Visual language is marketing-first with strong emphasis on trust signals (awards, press logos, star ratings) and a large primary call-to-action (CTA). The style mixes soft neutral backgrounds with saturated brand-blue hero surfaces, rounded geometry, prominent drop shadows, and bold condensed headlines for instant readability.

Canvas & background
- Screen size: mobile portrait (approx. 390 x 844pt / 1125 x 2436 px proportion). White / off-white full background (#F8F9F4). Slight ambient gradient top → bottom (very subtle, near-white to #F8F9F4) to give depth.

Top area / CTA
- Large pill CTA button centered horizontally near the top. Shape: fully rounded capsule with 48–64 px tall on 390pt width (approx. 56 px height). Width ~86% of viewport with equal side margins. Background: deep charcoal-blue gradient vertical from #2A3340 (top) to #1F2630 (bottom) producing subtle sheen. Inner shadow and soft drop shadow (RGBA(13,20,30,0.12), y-offset 8px, blur 18px) to lift. Text: “Start my 3-day Free trial” — white, bold, 18–20pt (iOS scale) / ~600–700 weight, center aligned. Letter spacing slightly condensed (-0.02em). Padding left/right ~28–32px. CTA has subtle pressed state: darker inner gradient and smaller shadow.
- Close icon: small circular floating button (40px diameter) positioned overlapping the right edge above CTA. Circle background white #FFFFFF, 1px subtle border #E6E6E6, drop shadow (RGBA(0,0,0,0.12), y 6px blur 12px). Centered “X” icon in dark gray #352823, 18–20px stroke.

Award row (trust signals)
- A horizontal three-column row under CTA inside the main column. Columns: (left) press logos stack, (center) large medal badge, (right) star-rating block.
- Left column: vertical stack of gray press logos (Forbes, Cosmopolitan, TechCrunch, Vogue, ABC News) treated as photos/monochrome grayscale images using ~70% opacity and subtle spacing. Each logo width ~70px; stacked centered in the column.
- Middle column: round golden medal emblem. Circular medal diameter ~140–160 px. Colors: inner gold #E99538 for iconography and #F7C84A / #F5B800 for highlight rings; subtle radial gradient #F2C94C → #E2A700; inner Apple mark and text “APPLE DESIGN AWARD” in slightly darker gold #CB8A1A; thin laurel glyphs on sides. Medal has thin darker outer stroke and soft drop shadow (RGBA(32,32,32,0.12)). Text inside medal uses small caps, condensed weight.
- Right column: rating block with large numeric “250,000+” in medium-dark gray #6B6B6B (~18–20pt) above a row of five star icons in gold (#E99538) and label “RATINGS” below in uppercase small text, gray #9A9A9A, tracking wide.

Section heading
- A small section heading center aligned: “Best Award-Winning water tracker:” Text color near-black #222222, weight 600, size ~16–18pt, margin top 18–22px and bottom 14px.

Hero award card (dominant blue card)
- Large rounded rectangle card occupying most of viewport width with heavy corner radius (24–28 px) and large vertical height (approx. 60–70% of viewport height). Background: vivid saturated blue #1D4BCA (primary brand blue). Card uses subtle linear gradient top-left (#215CD6) to bottom-right (#173FAF) and decorative thin circular line patterns (very low-opacity white strokes) drawn symmetrically to form concentric, overlapping geometric curves.
- Card content stacked vertically and center-aligned:
  - Top-left inside card: two overlapping soft 3D-like squared icons (one turquoise icon with a cartoon character and one blue App Store-like icon). These icons are illustrated, with slight perspective, drop shadow, and small offset to imply depth. The icons use bright cyan/teal and royal blue tones.
  - Main title: large white headline “App Store Award” on one line and “2022” on the next line. Typeface: heavy sans-serif (think Inter/BentonSans/Gilroy bold), weight 700–800, size ~28–36pt depending on density, line-height 1.05 for tight stacking; center aligned; color #FFFFFF.
  - Subtitle: “Cultural Impact Winner” lighter blue (#85A7FF or #95B7FF) using medium weight (500), size ~16–18pt, margin-top ~8–12px.
  - Decorative quote block near bottom (very light, low-contrast text in pale blue/white) — small author line “— Tim Cook, Apple CEO” and a longer congratulatory paragraph in faint translucent white (opacity ~18–25%) to serve as supporting text. Text size ~12–14pt, line-height 1.4.
- Card edge treatment: 2–3px inner highlight at top edge, subtle outer shadow (RGBA(12,24,80,0.14), y 18px blur 28px) to float.
- Small Apple icon watermark sits near the bottom-right corner of the card in white, slightly cropped by the corner radius.
- The card appears to be part of a horizontally swipeable carousel — rounded right edge of adjacent card is visible at the right edge of the screenshot. Include page control dots if recreating full carousel.

Typography
- Primary headings: heavy geometric/neo-grotesque sans (Inter, SF Pro Display, or Gilroy), bold 700–800. Sizes:
  - Hero title: 28–36pt (mobile scale)
  - CTA: 18–20pt bold
  - Section headings: 16–18pt semi-bold
  - Supporting text / quotes: 12–14pt regular, low opacity for tertiary content
- Line heights: headings 1.05–1.2, body 1.4–1.6. Text alignment mostly center for hero/CTA areas; left/center mix for other content.

Color palette (explicit)
- Off-white / page background: #F8F9F4
- Primary saturated blue (hero): #1D4BCA (provided)
- Hero gradient/darker: #173FAF / #215CD6
- Deep CTA charcoal: #352823 (provided) used as dark tone in pill (but slightly desaturated/blue-black in recreation)
- Accent gold / medal: #E99538 (provided) and supporting gold #F7C84A
- Secondary accent red / small highlights: #CB441B (provided) — used sparingly for micro-interactions or small icons
- Text colors: near-black #222222 for headings, medium gray #6B6B6B for meta, muted gray #9A9A9A for captions

Icons & imagery
- Use flat 2.5D illustrated icons for app badges; press logos in grayscale; star icons solid gold, compact.
- Apple/brand logos use vector shapes with crisp edges.

Shadows & surfaces
- Soft drop shadows for CTA and hero card (y offsets 8–20px, blur 12–28px) with low opacity black or deep-blue tints. Inner gentle highlights on pill and card to indicate gloss.

Interactions & microinteractions
- CTA: tap triggers modal or subscription flow; on press animate scale to 0.98 with a 120ms ease-in-out.
- Hero card: horizontally swipeable; on swipe, 300ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1) with crossfade/slide between cards.
- Floating close button: fade out overlay with 180ms ease.
- Star ratings might animate (fill-in) when the card first appears: 6opx stagger with ease-out.

Spacing & grid
- Global horizontal margin ~20–24px; vertical rhythm ~12–20px between stacked sections. Use a single-column flow (centered), with the trust row using a nested 3-column layout: left small column 22%, center 44%, right 34% (approx.) to balance medal.

Accessibility
- Text contrast: ensure hero title and CTA meet AA/AAA contrast. Provide alternative text for logos and icons. Touchable hit targets minimum 44 x 44 px for CTA and close button.

Notes for recreation
- Recreate decorative line patterns on blue card with thin white strokes at 6–8% opacity forming symmetric circular curves.
- Use vector medal with simple laurel shapes, inner text small-caps.
- Emulate the right-edge peek of a neighboring card to imply carousel.

Deliverables to hand off
- Symbols/components: Pill CTA, Floating Close, Medal Badge, Press Logos Stack, Rating Row, Hero Award Card (with decorative pattern layer separated), Page content stack.
- Tokens: color tokens (above hexes), typographic scale, shadow tokens (elevation levels), spacing scale.

content.layout:
Overall layout structure
- Primary layout: single vertical column (stack) layout optimized for mobile portrait. All major blocks are center-aligned in a single column flow.

Breakdown of groups and columns
1) Top CTA group (single column)
   - Full-width centered pill CTA (capsule) — one column.
   - Floating circular close button positioned overlapping the right side of the CTA (absolutely positioned within the same group).

2) Trust row (3-column nested grid inside the single column)
   - Nested grid with 3 columns horizontally across the content width: left (press logos stack), center (medal badge), right (ratings block). These three columns are balanced visually and centered in the available content width.
   - Column widths approximate: left 24%, center 44% (medal focal point), right 32%.

3) Section heading (single column)

- Close press: fade down/out animation to dismiss overlay (200–300ms ease-in).
- Legal links (Restore Purchases, Terms & Privacy, Help & Support): simple tap; Restore Purchases is emphasized and should be more saturated color and slightly larger than the two foot links.

Iconography & imagery:
- Cartoon-style avatar/emoji (rounded, friendly illustration) at the top-left of the card.
- Star icons for rating are flat, bright yellow, with no stroke.
- X icon in close button is simple, medium-thin stroke.

Visual hierarchy & accessibility:
- Strong emphasis on CTA (dark pill) and testimonial content. Use high contrast text on the green card for readability. Faded background heading is decorative and should stay decorative for screen readers (aria-hidden). Legal copy is low contrast but should meet minimum legibility for accessibility; consider slightly darker gray for better contrast.

Exact spacing examples (to replicate):
- Outer safe area on mobile 16 px left/right.
- Card horizontal padding 24 px, vertical padding 32 px.
- Avatar top-left offset 16 px from card content edges.
- Spacing between stars and headline 12–14 px; between headline and body 12–18 px.
- Bottom legal block margin-top ~22–28 px from cards.

This description provides the visual, typographic, spacing, color and interaction guidance needed to recreate the screen and maintain the same visual hierarchy and feel.
content.layout:
High-level layout: single-column centered modal overlay with a horizontally scrollable carousel of rounded cards. The composition stacks from top to bottom: decorative large faded heading at the top (background), a small close button to the top-right, the overlapping capsule CTA centered over the top of a primary testimonial card, the testimonial content card itself occupying the central area, and the legal/utility area at the bottom with a primary link and two secondary links.

Columns & groups:
- Primary layout column: one main column (center alignment) containing the CTA, the card carousel, and the legal/footer group.
- Carousel group: a horizontal group of cards (1 row, multiple columns generated by the carousel). The active card is centered; adjacent cards are partially visible to the sides.

Grid details:
- The card uses an internal content grid: one column layout inside the card for avatar + rating + headline + paragraph + attribution, with consistent left alignment for text. Internal spacing uses repeated vertical rhythm (12–18 px increments).

Counts & geometry:
- Column count: 1 main column for the screen. Card internal columns: 1.
- Carousel grid: 1 row x N columns (N >= 2), with each column = one testimonial card. Horizontal gap between cards is ~12–18 px; visible peeking of next card indicates negative space/offset.

Layout keywords (see separate list) describe the visual arrangement and components.
content.functions:
Specific actions users can take on this screen:
- Tap the primary CTA pill "Start my 3-day Free trial" to begin the subscription checkout/onboarding flow. The CTA is prominent and centered; pressing it gives immediate tactile feedback and triggers the purchase flow.
- Close the overlay by tapping the circular X button in the top-right to return to the previous screen without subscribing.
- Swipe left/right on the card area to browse additional testimonial cards (carousel). The peek of a pink card on the right visually suggests horizontal scrolling.
- Read the text content of the testimonial: view rating (stars), headline, body copy, and the small attribution "— App Store review".
- Tap "Restore Purchases" to re-check prior purchases (non-destructive action that likely triggers a restore flow via the store). This link is emphasized and placed centrally to aid returning paying users.
- Tap the footer links "Terms & Privacy" and "Help & Support" to view legal information or access customer support resources.
- Scroll the legal text if it overflows; the area is scrollable or static depending on implementation.

Medium-level tasks (combined interactions):
- Evaluate the product credibility by reading user testimonials and ratings, then decide whether to start the free trial.
- Recover a previous purchase or verify subscription status by tapping Restore Purchases and, if needed, navigate to support via Help & Support.
- Navigate between different testimonials or promotional cards to compare social proof before converting.

Broader goals enabled by this screen:
- Convert free users to paid subscribers by presenting social proof (testimonial + rating) alongside an immediate conversion CTA (3-day free trial).
- Provide a low-friction path for returning users to restore purchases and for new users to access legal and support information, increasing trust.
- Maintain context and reversibility: the close button and clearly labeled restore/help links allow users to exit or pursue alternatives without committing, thereby reducing friction and exit friction.

How UI supports these tasks:
- Strong contrast and large capsule CTA guide attention to conversion action.
- Testimonial card with avatar, stars and long-form quote builds trust and provides social proof.
- Carousel affordance (peeking card) encourages exploration of additional testimonials.
- Legal text and restore link placed in the lower region keep compliance visible while not overshadowing the conversion CTA.

steps.name: Platform payment sheet
steps.goal: Let the user confirm payment using the platform-native purchase UI.
steps.action: The Apple payment/confirmation sheet appears showing: app name, '3-day free trial', price (8,99 € per year), renewal date and account info. User confirms by using the device's side button (Double Click/Confirm).
steps.system_response: iOS handles authentication (Face ID/Side Button) and communicates with the App Store. The purchase request is submitted.

content.description:
Overview
- Full-screen mobile subscription / paywall overlay that emphasizes social proof (an App Store review) inside a rounded testimonial card, with a prominent CTA pill overlapping the top of the card and legal/restore links below. The design uses bold solid color cards in a horizontal carousel so neighboring cards peek on both sides.

Canvas and background
- Screen size: portrait mobile (iPhone style). Status bar visible at top (time, cellular/Wi‑Fi/battery) indicating iOS device.
- Background: very light off-white (#FFFFFF / #FBFCFB) with a large, very faint headline centered near the top (“Recommended by 264,859 people”) set as a semi-transparent large display text (light grey ~ #F0F1F2 at 10–15% opacity) placed behind the card to create depth.

Main testimonial card (central element)
- Shape & layout: single vertical card with large rounded corners (corner radius ~28–36 px). Card width ~ 86–90% of viewport width with the left and right edges of adjacent cards visible as narrow color strips (peeking effect) indicating a horizontal carousel.
- Card background color: vivid orange (#F6A106) filling entire card surface.
- Padding: internal padding ~24–32 px from card edges. Content left-aligned.
- Elevation and shadow: slight drop shadow under the CTA pill and subtle card shadow to lift from the background (shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.08), blur 12px, y-offset 6px).

Top overlay CTA pill
- Shape: large rounded capsule/pill overlapping card top edge and centered horizontally. Capsule extends beyond card edges slightly and sits partially above card. Capsule corner radius is high (fully rounded ends). Height ~48 px, width ~70–80% of card width.
- Background color: deep navy / slate (#3E2A68). Inner text is all-caps sentence case white text: “Start my 3-day Free trial” in bold. Text color: #FFFFFF. Text size ~16–18 px semibold.
- Shadow: subtle outer shadow to separate from card (rgba(0,0,0,0.12), blur 10px).

Close control
- A circular white button with an “X” icon sits near the top-right of the viewport overlapping the background (not on the card). Circle diameter ~44 px, background #FFFFFF, icon color #3E2A68, light shadow (rgba(0,0,0,0.08)). Tap target conforms to 44–48 px.

Card content (top to bottom)
- Small emoji-style avatar/icon at top-left inside card (circular character illustration with beanie) ~40 px diameter.
- Rating row directly under avatar: five star icons, filled solid yellow (#F6C623 or similar). Star icon size ~20–22 px with 8–12 px spacing.
- Headline (review title): bold, left-aligned, white text, size ~20–22 px, weight 700. Example: “I used for a day and immediately purchased the premium features! 😅”. Line-height ~1.15–1.3.
- Body copy: paragraph text, white with 90–95% opacity (or slightly lighter white). Font size ~15–16 px regular weight (400), line-height ~1.5–1.6 for readability. The body text occupies multiple lines and is left-aligned. Paragraph has top margin ~12–16 px from headline.
- Attribution line: small muted text (“— App Store review”), very light white / pale grey (#FFFFFF with 55–65% opacity or #AEB2B6), font-size ~13 px, margin-top ~18 px.

Adjacent cards
- Narrow visible edges on left and right: left card in cyan/teal (#049CFB) and right card in pink/red (#DA2B4E) giving a colorful carousel feel. These are the same rounded-corner card shapes but mostly off-screen with just their curved edges visible.

Lower legal area and links (below the carousel)
- Small legal paragraph (subscription details) in small muted grey text (#AEB2B6). Font-size ~12–13 px, centered, multiple short lines with ample line-height ~1.4. This block is horizontally centered and margins ~20–28 px from card bottom.
- “Restore Purchases” CTA: centered link in bright cyan (#049CFB), bold (600–700), size ~16 px, with ~10 px vertical spacing from legal copy. It’s an inline text CTA (not button-shaped) with a larger tap area.
- Footer row: two inline links spaced horizontally: “Terms & Privacy” and “Help & Support” in subdued grey (#AEB2B6 / #9AA0A6), font-size ~14 px, centered on the screen. These sit below the restore link with margin ~12–18 px and are often placed in a two-column arrangement visually centered.

Typography
- System feel: uses an iOS system sans (San Francisco / SF Pro) or similar geometric sans-serif. Hierarchy:
  - Headline (review title): 20–22 px, Bold (600–700), left-aligned inside card.
  - Rating icons: ~20 px.
  - Body: 15–16 px Regular (400), left-aligned.
  - Attribution/legal: 12–13 px Light/Regular (300–400), centered below the card.
  - CTA pill text: 16–18 px SemiBold/600.
- All text is left-aligned inside the card; global footer links are centered.

Colors (explicit)
- Cyan / Accent: #049CFB — used for left adjacent card edge and the Restore Purchases link.
- Primary orange (testimonial card): #F6A106 — dominant card background.
- Deep navy (CTA pill and small UI accents): #3E2A68 — CTA background and the X icon color.
- Muted grey (legal / attribution): #AEB2B6 — small explanatory copy and subtle UI.
- Pink / Accent: #DA2B4E — right adjacent card edge.
- White / bright text: #FFFFFF — headline and large text inside the orange card.

Icons & illustrations
- Avatar is an illustrated emoji-like face (flat vector illustration) used as reviewer identity.
- Star rating icons are solid filled stars in yellow. X close icon is a dark glyph inside white circular button.

Interactions & states (visual)
- Carousel: horizontal swipe to reveal adjacent testimonial cards. Peeking edges provide affordance. Card in focus is centered, larger, and fully visible; adjacent cards are partially visible.
- CTA pill is tappable; on press it should show a pressed state (slightly darker navy, scale down to 0.98) and then the purchase/trial flow.
- Close button dismisses overlay/modal.
- Restore Purchases is a tappable link; on active state it can change to a slightly darker cyan (#037BD8).
- Links in footer are tappable and should have underline or color change on press.

Accessibility notes
- Sufficient contrast for bold white headline on orange background; body text should use 95% opacity white or off-white for legibility.
- Tap targets follow mobile minimums (44–48 px). Line heights increased for readability. Ensure voiceover reads CTA text and labels for stars and avatar.

Animation suggestions
- Carousel transition: horizontal slide with easing cubic-bezier(0.22,0.8,0.32,1), 300–420 ms.
- CTA pill overlapping appear animation: upward translateY from +12 px and fade-in, 220 ms ease-out.
- Close button hover/press: scale to 0.96 with 120 ms ease.

Notes for reproduction
- Keep the capsule CTA overlapping the card top — it’s a strong visual anchor on the screen.
- Recreate the peeking left/right cards with contrasting brand accent colors for the carousel affordance.
- Use a large faint background headline text behind the card to add depth and social proof context.
content.layout:
Overall layout structure
- Single-column mobile layout (one main column). The layout can be considered as vertically stacked groups/rows:
  1. Status bar area (system) and faint background headline behind the carousel.
  2. Carousel container (primary area) — contains a horizontally scrollable group of cards. Within the carousel: 1 main central card (full content) and parts of at least two adjacent cards on left and right.
  3. Legal / descriptive text block (centered) below the carousel.
  4. Restore Purchases CTA (centered link) below legal text.
  5. Footer links row with two centered items (Terms & Privacy | Help & Support).

Columns & groups
- Column count: 1 primary column.
- Groups inside column: 4 main groups (Carousel card group, legal text group, restore CTA group, footer links group).
- Carousel grid: horizontal single-row deck acting as a channel (1 row x N cards). Each card uses full-width within the carousel viewport with spacing between cards equal to the peeking width.

Spacing & alignment
- All major blocks are center-aligned relative to screen width. Card content inside each card is left-aligned with consistent internal padding. Footer links are horizontally centered and split into two textual links.

Keywords to describe layout
- Single-column
- Horizontal carousel
- Centered card
- Overlapping CTA
- Large rounded corners
- Peeking adjacent cards
- Centered legal block
- Footer links row
- Floating close button
- Full-screen overlay
content.functions:
Specific actions supported on this screen
- Read testimonial: users can scroll (if content longer) or visually scan the centered review card to assess a user testimonial and rating.
- Swipe carousel: users can horizontally swipe left or right to view other testimonial cards — peeking adjacent cards provide affordance for this interaction.
- Start free trial: tapping the prominent overlapping CTA pill (“Start my 3-day Free trial”) begins the conversion flow (subscribe/trial sign-up). The CTA has active/pressed states and should trigger a modal or in-app purchase flow.
- Close/dismiss: tap the circular X in the top-right to close the overlay and return to the previous screen.
- Restore purchases: tap the cyan “Restore Purchases” link to trigger platform-specific restore flow (e.g., check App Store receipts) and receive success/error feedback.
- Access legal/support: tap “Terms & Privacy” or “Help & Support” links at the bottom to navigate to policy or support content (likely opens webview or page).

Medium-level tasks (combined actions)
- Evaluate product value: by reading the testimonial and star rating, the user gains social proof which reduces friction and helps them decide whether to start the trial.
- Start or restore subscription: user either begins the 3-day trial via the CTA or recovers previous purchases via the restore action. Both actions typically lead to verification/confirmation flows or App Store interactions.
- Explore more testimonials: users can swipe through the carousel to read multiple reviews quickly, forming a broader impression of the product.

Broader goals achieved with this screen
- Conversion: primary business goal is to convert free users to paying customers by offering a time-limited trial plus social proof.
- Trust & transparency: inclusion of an actual App Store review, star rating, and subscription legal copy builds trust and informs users about billing/auto-renew rules.
- Recovery of previous transactions: the restore purchases link supports returning customers and reduces friction for reactivation or troubleshooting.

How UI supports tasks
- Visual hierarchy and high-contrast CTA draw attention to the trial signup.
- Large, readable testimonial with star rating provides quick social proof; avatar humanizes the review.
- Peeking cards and swipe affordance encourage exploration without overwhelming the user.
- Legal copy and restore link are placed nearby to address common objections (billing transparency, prior purchases) without distracting primary CTA.

steps.name: Purchase success alert

content.description: Portrait iPhone screen showing a full-screen subscription/paywall flow with a large centered testimonial card in a horizontal carousel and a persistent legal/footer area at the bottom. Overall style: friendly, colorful, skeuomorphic-lite with heavy rounded corners, soft shadows, and large readable typography (iOS San Francisco / system font). The dominant visual is a single rounded-rectangle card (center) in a deep burgundy (approx #981E3C) occupying roughly the top 65% of the safe-area height and inset from left/right by ~18 px. Partial neighboring cards are visible at left (warm orange) and right (brown), creating a carousel feel. Card corners are large radius (~28-34 px). Inside the card, at top-left is a small circular avatar/illustration (diameter ~48 px) with a thin white/pale outline and a playful illustrated face wearing sunglasses. Below the avatar is a five-star rating row; stars are high-contrast yellow/gold (approx #F2C029 / or main accent #A97811) each ~22-28 px and spaced ~8 px. The testimonial title is a large, heavy-weight headline using a white/pale text color (approx #F3F3F4), left aligned, 28–36 px font size, 700 weight, with ~8–12 px line-height extra for emphasis. The testimonial body copy sits beneath the headline in a mid-gray/pale color (approx #E5D9D9 / or light gray), regular weight, ~16–18 px, 1.4 line-height, with an inline emoji (llama) that preserves baseline. At the bottom of the card is a muted attribution line “— App Store review” in a very pale/low-contrast gray (approx #B3B3B3) and smaller size (~13–14 px). The card background shows no heavy texture — flat solid color. Over the top center of the card (overlapping top edge) is a dark rounded capsule modal with a spinner/loading indicator centered inside; the capsule is nearly black / deep navy (approx #251E1A to #0F1114) with a subtle inner shadow and soft outer drop shadow to lift from the card. The spinner is a white/very pale radial segmented loader (rotating). In the top-right corner of the screen (outside the card) is a circular close button (white circle with an 'X' icon in dark gray) sized ~44 px. The status bar area is visible at the very top (9:41 and iOS indicators). Below the carousel area is a tall light-gray content area (pale neutral background approx #ECECEC or #F0F0F0) that contains dense legal copy centered horizontally in a narrow column (multiline paragraph, very small font ~12–13 px, color #9A9A9A / #B3B3B3). Beneath the legal copy is a prominent action link “Restore Purchases” in a bright teal/turquoise accent (approx #00B2C7) 18–20 px, semi-bold, centered and tappable. Finally two low-contrast links “Terms & Privacy” and “Help & Support” appear below in gray (approx #7E7E7E) smaller size with spacing between them. Spacing and padding: side margins of main content ~18–22 px, card interior padding ~24 px, headline margin-bottom ~12 px, body margin-bottom ~18 px. Visual depth & microcopy: subtle confetti dots or tiny decorative specks near the avatar/heading add playful personality. Typography: primary system font (San Francisco), headline ~32 px bold (SF Pro Display / 700), body ~16 px regular (SF Pro Text / 400), small legal ~12 px regular (400). Colors (approx): burgundy card #981E3C; dark capsule/overlay #251E1A; purple/dark accent #3C1C9B (used elsewhere in palette/background glimpses); stars/gold #A97811 or #F2C029; legal gray #B3B3B3; restore link teal #00B2C7; light page background #ECECEC. States & interactions: testimonial cards swipe horizontally with a slow eased carousel animation (cubic-bezier(0.22,0.9,0.36,1)), active card centered and slightly scaled up (scale 1.02) while inactive neighbor cards are slightly scaled down and dimmed (opacity 0.6). The dark capsule with spinner fades in/out on loading events (fade 180ms, ease-out) and the spinner rotates infinitely (1s per rotation, linear). Close button has a tap ripple/scale microinteraction (100ms). The Restore Purchases link appears as a text button (no filled background) but uses a bright accent for prominence; on tap it shows a temporary toast / loading spinner and then a confirmation modal. Overall feel: playful and friendly but clearly transactional — built to reassure users with social proof (testimonial + 5-star) while offering restore and help links in the footer.
content.layout: Single-column portrait layout with two stacked vertical regions: (1) Top region: horizontal carousel container holding three rounded cards (center card fully visible, left and right cards partially visible). Carousel uses a single row, one item per view. The center card is the primary group and contains three internal vertical groups: header (avatar + star row), main content (headline and body text), footer attribution (source line). The capsule spinner overlays the top center edge of the center card (absolute position) and partially overlaps the card's top edge. A circular close control sits in the top-right safe area outside the card (absolute). (2) Bottom region: full-width footer column (light background) containing long legal paragraph centered in a narrow text column, followed by a primary text-action link centered (“Restore Purchases”), and a lower row with two secondary links spaced horizontally and centered. Column counts: overall single main column. Inside the center card: one column, three vertical groups as described. Carousel grid: 1 row x 3 visible items (center + two partial). Padding: global horizontal padding ~18–22 px; vertical spacing between card and footer ~12–18 px. Key layout keywords: centered card, carousel, single-column, bottom sheet-style footer, overlapping overlay, absolute positioned close, safe-area aware margins.
content.functions: Smallest actions: - Tap the circular Close ('X') button to dismiss the modal/overlay. - Swipe left or right across the testimonial card area to browse neighboring testimonials (carousel interaction). - Tap the spinner capsule (if actionable) to retry or view a loading state (spinner indicates background work). - Tap the 'Restore Purchases' link to trigger the in-app restore flow; tapping shows immediate feedback (spinner/toast) and then success/error confirmation. - Tap the 'Terms & Privacy' or 'Help & Support' links to open respective documents or support flows. Medium-level tasks / workflows: - Read social proof (5-star rating + headline + body text) to build trust before purchasing or subscribing. - Use the ‘Restore Purchases’ action to recover prior purchases without going through full purchase flow — the UI provides clear feedback (loading spinner, success toast). - Browse multiple testimonials via carousel to get multiple endorsements, or close the modal and continue the subscription/purchase process. Broader/primary goal: The screen's purpose is to act as part of a subscription/paywall flow — to present social proof (testimonials) that increases conversion confidence and to provide post-purchase account recovery (restore purchases) and legal transparency (terms & privacy). The interface balances persuasion (big testimonial card with rating) with essential transactional actions (restore purchases, help), giving users quick access to help or recovery while they decide about a purchase or subscription.
