content.description:
Overview
- Single-column, mobile portrait screen for creating / editing a beverage/product. Clean, minimal iOS-style aesthetic with large centered illustration and a vertical list of rounded form rows beneath. Top-of-screen controls allow cancelling and saving. A pale pill under the status bar shows a contextual suggestion "Similar to: Starbucks Pumpkin Spice Latte" with a small caret (dropdown affordance).

Color palette (use these exact HEX values where noted)
- Primary orange (illustration, accent): #E37304
- Accent blue (used for small interactive elements, not dominant here): #0474E4 (present in project brand but not prominent on this screen)
- Dark text / icons: #3C3128
- Page background / card background: #FBFBFB (very light off-white)
- Muted label / secondary text: #9FADBD
- Additional translucent/soft peach for suggestion pill background: #FFEBD8 (approx; lightened tint of orange)

Typography
- System / geometric sans (SF Pro / Inter style) with clear hierarchy:
  - Small control labels (top left / right): uppercase, 13–14px, semibold (600), letter spacing +0.5px. Color: #3C3128 on light backgrounds (Cancel) or white on dark Save pill.
  - Suggestion pill text: 14–15px, medium weight (500), color #E37304 (primary orange) centered horizontally; pill background is a very pale peach.
  - Section labels in rows (e.g., "Name", "Size", "Icon", "Color"): 16px, medium (600) or semi-bold, color #3C3128.
  - Field values on the right (e.g., "Pumpkin Latte", "16oz"): 15px, medium weight (500) or regular with muted color #9FADBD.

Top controls
- Cancel control (top-left): rounded pill with subtle elevated drop shadow. White background (#FBFBFB) with inner shadow to suggest tactile surface; text uppercase "CANCEL" in #9FADBD / #3C3128 (muted). Approx 44–48px height, horizontal padding ~20px, corner radius ~22px.
- Save control (top-right): dark rounded pill (approx #3C3128 or deep navy) with white label "SAVE" in 13–14px semibold. Same height as Cancel. Positioned flush to safe area with ~16–20px margin from top and sides. Subtle drop shadow below to lift it.

Suggestion pill
- Centered under status bar / top controls. Full-width-ish pill but with side padding leaving margins to screen edges. Background pale peach (#FFEBD8) with rounded capsule corners (corner radius ~28–30px). Text centered in orange (#E37304). Small downward caret icon on the right inside the pill to indicate dropdown. Height ~44px. Soft shadow and subtle inner highlight to suggest an interactive control.

Hero illustration
- Large stylized flat illustration of a mug with whipped top, filled with primary orange #E37304. Illustration centered, approximately occupying 40-45% of the vertical viewport (from just under the suggestion pill to above the form rows). Illustration has small accent shapes in very light peach or white for highlights, and a small white squiggle on the whipped cream. The illustration sits on the white page background and has no border.

Form rows (Cards)
- A stack of rounded rectangular cards / rows beneath the hero illustration. Each row is a pill-shaped rectangle with background #FBFBFB (same as page but slightly elevated using a faint shadow to separate it). Card corner radius ~20px–24px. Left area contains an icon (outlined dark #3C3128) representing the field (tag icon for Name, ruler for Size, crop/box for Icon, palette for Color). Center-left is the label (e.g., "Name") in 16px semi-bold #3C3128. Right aligned content (value) displayed on the far right in muted #9FADBD (e.g., "Pumpkin Latte", "16oz") or a small colored preview (for Icon a small orange mug thumbnail; for Color a small circular swatch using #E37304). Each card height ~64px, horizontal padding ~20px, vertical spacing between cards ~18–22px. There is a thin horizontal spacing / separator line between the 'Size' group and the Icon/Color group (visible as a faint line or larger gap).

Row specific details
- Name row: left tag icon, label "Name", right value text "Pumpkin Latte" in muted grey.
- Size row: left ruler icon, label "Size", right value "16oz".
- Icon row: left crop/box icon, label "Icon", right a small thumbnail orange mug (filled #E37304) inside the card.
- Color row: left palette icon, label "Color", right a circular swatch filled with #E37304.

Spacing and layout metrics (approx)
- Safe area top margin: 16–20px from status bar. Suggestion pill top ~40–48px from top of screen.
- Suggestion pill horizontal margins: 18–24px from screen edges.
- Hero illustration vertical gap below pill: ~20–30px. Illustration centered horizontally.
- From illustration bottom to first card top: ~36–48px.
- Card horizontal margins: 18–22px. Card height ~64px. Inter-card vertical gap ~16–22px.
- Bottom of visible cards finishes before device bottom safe area leaving ~24–36px.

Shadows, borders, and effects
- Cards: very soft shadow (blur radius ~12px, opacity 6–10%) and a subtle 1px inner highlight near top edge to give a raised, tactile look.
- Suggestion pill: slightly stronger shadow so it appears floating.
- Buttons: slightly stronger shadow to indicate interactivity.

Interaction states & microcopy
- Suggestion pill: tapping opens a dropdown list of suggested similar drinks (caret indicates). Dropdown animation: quick scale + fade, 160–220ms ease-out.
- Cards: tapping a row navigates to an edit control (text input modal or inline edit). When editing, right-side values become text fields with blinking cursor and standard iOS keyboard. Disabled state uses even lighter text (#C7D0D8).
- Save button: disabled state light grey / lower opacity; active state dark with white text and a micro bounce animation on tap (120ms). Cancel triggers a confirm if there are unsaved changes (modal style iOS alert).

Animation
- Subtle entrance animation when screen appears: hero illustration fades/scale from 0.98 to 1.00 over 220ms, cards slide up into view with a stagger (40ms gap). Buttons have micro-interaction tap feedback: scale 0.98 for 80ms.

Assets & icons
- Icons are simple outline glyphs, 20–24px square, stroke weight ~2px in #3C3128. Right-side values use separate iconography (swatch, small thumbnail image) clipped to a rounded square.

Accessibility
- High contrast between dark text (#3C3128) and background (#FBFBFB). Buttons sized for 44px minimum touch targets. Labels and values large enough to meet readability.

Overall style
- Friendly, modern, illustrative product-edit form. Uses large flat illustration as the focal point and uses card-like pill rows to expose editable properties. Visual language is soft with rounded corners, muted greys for secondary information, and a single strong warm accent (#E37304) for product visuals and color swatches.
content.layout:
Overall structure
- Single-column vertical flow. All elements are centered horizontally within the safe area and arranged top-to-bottom: status bar → top controls (Cancel / Save) → suggestion pill → hero illustration → stacked form rows (cards) → bottom safe area.

Columns & groups
- Column count: 1 main content column.
- Within each card, there is effectively a 3-column micro-grid: icon area (left, fixed width ~40px), label area (center, flexible), and value area (right, fixed width ~80–120px) for right-aligned field values or small preview.
- Groups: the form rows are a single grouped list (one group) but visually there is a separator / extra spacing mid-list to indicate a grouping between general attributes (Name, Size) and presentation attributes (Icon, Color).

Grids
- No multi-column grid across the screen; hero illustration occupies a full width block centered within margins. The card list is a single-column list grid with consistent row height and spacing.

Spacing & alignment
- All cards share identical horizontal margins and corner radii. Icons align vertically centered in each card. Labels are left-aligned inside the card content area. Values are right-aligned and vertically centered.

Keywords to describe the layout: centered single-column, stacked cards, pill header, hero-centered illustration, micro-grid rows (icon/label/value), generous vertical whitespace, floating top controls, safe-area aligned, full-bleed illustration margin, tactile shadows.
content.functions:
Specific (element-level) actions users can take on this screen
- Tap "CANCEL" (top-left): dismiss editor or go back. If unsaved changes exist, show a confirmation alert. Visual feedback: subtle pressed state and micro animation.
- Tap "SAVE" (top-right): commit changes to the item. If required fields are empty, show inline validation or a modal explaining missing fields.
- Tap suggestion pill "Similar to: ...": open a dropdown or popover with suggested presets or alternate product matches. User can select a suggestion to auto-fill values.
- Tap any rounded card row (Name, Size, Icon, Color): open an inline editor or modal for that attribute. Name opens a text field (onscreen keyboard appears). Size opens a small selection list or wheel picker (e.g., 8oz/12oz/16oz). Icon opens an icon picker or image selector. Color opens a color picker or palette modal.
- Tap the right-side thumbnail / swatch: quick preview or toggle between available icons/colors.
- Scroll the list: if more fields exist, the page scrolls vertically. The hero illustration can either remain fixed or scroll off-screen depending on the implementation.
- While editing text fields, the onscreen keyboard appears and cards shift to remain visible.

Medium-level workflows
- Create a new product: user enters a name, selects size, chooses icon and color, then taps Save. The suggestion pill can prefill values or present templates.
- Edit an existing product: user adjusts one or more attributes and uses Save to persist changes or Cancel to revert.
- Use a preset: user opens the suggestion dropdown to select a preset (e.g., Starbucks Pumpkin Spice Latte) which populates fields; user may then tweak values and save.

Broader goal supported by the screen
- The screen's primary purpose is to let the user define or edit a beverage/product record with a strong visual preview (hero illustration) and clear, bite-sized editable attributes. The design emphasizes quick recognition (big illustration + color swatch) and fast editing using self-contained rows for each attribute. The flow supports clarity (labels aligned with icons), efficiency (direct tap to edit), and safety (prominent Save/Cancel controls and confirmation for unsaved changes).

content.description: Full-screen, single-column selection screen with a large illustrative product icon (orange mug) at the top, a centered title, a vertical list of three size options with the middle option visually selected, and two large rounded action buttons anchored near the bottom. Background: solid very light off-white (#FBFBFB). Status bar area at very top (system time and signal icons) preserved with 44 px safe area. Illustration: flat, minimal vector of a mug filled with foam, solid fill color #E27305 (orange). Illustration sits centered horizontally and occupies roughly 22-26% of screen height; approximate size 140–180 px square on a 375 px width baseline. Title: single word “Size” centered below the illustration. Typographic treatment: use a geometric / humanist sans (iOS system San Francisco or similar). Title font weight semibold/700, font-size ~28–32 px, line-height 34–38 px, color dark charcoal #3D3329. Option list: three stacked numeric labels (14.5oz, 15.0oz, 15.5oz) vertically centered under the title with large vertical spacing between items (about 28–40 px). Middle option is the active/selected state presented as a horizontally-stretched rounded pill (light grey fill ~ #F1F2F3 or #FBFBFB with subtle shadow), width ~ 84% of screen width, height ~56 px, border-radius ~28 px. Selected label text: bold (~700), dark #3D3329, font-size ~20–22 px; unselected labels: subdued neutral grey #A8ACB1, font-weight 500, font-size ~18 px. The selected pill has a subtle inner elevation/highlight: 4–8 px vertical soft shadow (rgba(61,51,41,0.06)) and a faint top highlight. The unselected items are plain text only, vertically spaced above and below the pill. Action area (bottom): two large pill buttons side-by-side centered horizontally with slight overlap gap. Left button: “Cancel” — white background #FBFBFB, text color dark #3D3329, subtle drop shadow (rgba(61,51,41,0.12), blur 30px, y-offset 10px), radius ~36 px, padding horizontal ~34 px, vertical ~18 px, font-size ~18–20 px, weight 600. Right button: “Apply” — filled dark background #3D3329, text white #FBFBFB, same size and radius. Both buttons appear to float above background with soft outer glow and shadow. Overall alignment: center-aligned elements with generous whitespace. Visual style: minimal, friendly, modern iOS-style—flat illustration, large touch targets, rounded geometry, muted neutral palette with a high-contrast accent (orange). Interaction affordances: selected pill communicates selection via contrast, size and elevation; buttons are large and visually primary/secondary. Colors used in screen: dark text / primary button: #3D3329, accent illustration: #E27305, secondary accent (unused here) #0474E4 (present in provided palette but not visually dominant on this screen), page background: #FBFBFB, muted text/disabled: #A8ACB1. Corner radii: illustration contained with no corner radius (vector shape); pill and buttons radius ~28–36 px. Spacing: top safe area 44 px; illustration top margin ~24–36 px from status bar; title margin ~18 px below illustration; option list vertical spacing ~20–36 px; bottom buttons area bottom safe inset ~24–34 px from bottom. Microinteractions (recommended): when user scrolls or taps another option, animate pill slide/fade to new selection (duration 140–180ms, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)). Button press: scale to 0.98 with 80ms ease-in and shadow reduction. Selection confirmation: optional subtle confetti or checkmark toast (short 300ms).
content.layout: Single-column, vertically stacked layout with center alignment. Top safe area / status row (1 row) then a top illustration block (1 column) centered. Below that a single heading block (1 column). Under the heading is a small vertical list of three rows (list: 3 rows) where the middle row is a full-width rounded pill (tile) and the top/bottom rows are simple text list items. Bottom area contains a horizontal group of 2 columns (two buttons) centered; these two buttons are visually grouped and anchored near the bottom safe inset. No multi-column grids; the only horizontal grouping is the bottom two-button row. Summary: 1 column main flow; list grid = 3 rows x 1 column; bottom action group = 1 row x 2 columns (buttons). Key spacing: large top/mid whitespace to keep focus on single attribute. Keywords to describe layout: center-aligned, single-column, vertical-stack, full-width-pill, bottom-action-row, floating-buttons, large-illustration, three-item-list, safe-area-aware, generous-whitespace.
content.functions: Direct (element-level) actions: - Tap on any size label to select it. Tapping the middle item (15.0oz) either selects it (if not already selected) or moves the highlighted pill to that row. The selected item is presented inside a horizontal rounded pill that visually differentiates it from the other two labels. - Tap the Cancel button to dismiss the selector without saving changes. - Tap the Apply button to confirm the selected size and apply it to the product or the current configuration. Medium-level tasks / workflows: - Change a product variant: user inspects the illustration/title to confirm they are editing size, then chooses a preferred option from the list and confirms with Apply. - Preview before confirming: illustration + title provide context so the user can quickly verify they are editing the correct attribute (size) before finalizing. - Dismiss without change: user can bail out via Cancel to preserve previous selection. Broader purpose: - This screen acts as a focused product-option selector within a purchase or customization flow (for example in-product variant selection on a product details or checkout flow). It enables quick, unambiguous selection of a single attribute (size) with clear confirm/cancel affordances. The design prioritizes clarity, large touch targets for accessibility, and minimal cognitive load so users can make and confirm choices quickly. Visual feedback (pill highlight, color contrast, shadows, micro-interactions) reinforces selection and completion.

content.functions: Specific actions (per-card): - Tap the CANCEL pill: discard changes and close the editor (secondary action). - Tap the SAVE pill: validate inputs and persist changes; show a success confirmation. - Tap a card (Name): opens a text input modal or inline editable text field where the user can enter or edit the drink name. The UI shows a cursor, keyboard and Save/Done actions. - Tap Size: opens a single-choice selector (list or segmented control) to pick a size (e.g., 12oz, 15oz). - Tap Icon: opens an icon picker / gallery where the user can choose a glyph; the chosen icon shows as a small filled preview at the right of the card. - Tap Color: opens a color palette or swatch picker; selected swatch shows as a filled circular badge on the right. - Tap Animation: opens a list of animation presets (e.g., Micro Bubbles); selection updates the right-side label. - Tap Hydration: opens a numeric slider or stepper to set hydration percentage; the chosen percent is shown in bright accent color (turquoise) on the card. - Tap Caffeine: opens a numeric input or preset list (e.g., 0/25/50/75/100) and displays mg value in warm accent color when set. - Tap Alcohol: toggles or opens a selector for Yes/No; current value shown in right-side text (colored). UI support for these actions: - Visual previews on the right provide immediate feedback (icon, dot, percentage, mg, No). - Cards visually press and highlight to indicate interactivity. - Group separators (thin center dividers) indicate related sections. Medium-level tasks / workflows: - Configure a new drink profile: enter a Name, select Size and Icon, choose Color and Animation, then adjust metrics (Hydration, Caffeine, Alcohol). - Edit an existing drink: change one or more cards and either Save or Cancel. - Preview updates inline via right-side visuals before saving. Broader purpose: - This screen is an item-level editor / settings editor focused on customizing properties of a single product or entity (a drink). It centralizes attribute controls for quick scanning and fast edits while preserving mobile-friendliness (large touch targets, clear visual hierarchy). The layout helps users quickly compare and tweak both visual (icon, color, animation) and metric attributes (hydration, caffeine, alcohol) before saving a cohesive configuration.

content.description:
Full-screen icon selection interface on an iPhone-style canvas (safe area visible). Overall style: minimal, flat, highly simplified pictogram silhouettes with a single accent color used to indicate selection. Background: very light warm white (#FBFBFB). Primary accent color for selected item and preview: orange (#E27305). Secondary dark control color used for the primary action (Apply): deep desaturated dark (use 0x3C3227 as shown). Neutral placeholder / disabled icon color: pale grey (#E2E3DD). Large preview area: centered near the top, showing a single large filled orange mug illustration with subtle rounded corners on shapes. Below the preview is a multi-row, multi-column grid of smaller icon silhouettes (all single-color fills). Most items are disabled/ghosted with the pale grey; one grid item is active and matches the orange accent and is reflected in the preview. Visual hierarchy is clear: large preview (dominant), icon grid (secondary), action controls (high visual weight due to size and shadow).

Typography: system San Francisco / Inter-style neutral sans (use SF Pro Text for iOS). Status bar numerals use small system weight ~12 pt. Primary button labels use medium/semibold weight ~17–18 pt; color for the dark button label is #FBFBFB (white) and for the light cancel button label is a dark navy/brown (~#3C3227). Line-height for button text ~22 pt. Alignment: centered horizontally for preview and grid, buttons centered as a pair horizontally. 

Iconography and shapes: icons are flat single-fill vector silhouettes with soft rounded corners (corner radius approx 8–12% of icon box), consistent stroke-free shapes. Grid icons are square bounding boxes with internal pictogram centered. The active grid item uses full fill #E27305 and includes a small highlight (straw/cream) at the top; disabled items use uniform pale grey fill with no stroke.

Spacing & sizes (reference for 375pt wide iPhone viewport): safe area left/right margins 16 pt. Large preview icon: approx 140–160 pt square, centered; top margin from status bar ~48–64 pt. Grid: 5 columns, each cell approx 56 pt square with 20 pt horizontal gap and 18–22 pt vertical gap. Grid top margin from preview ~36 pt. Visible rows: about 6–7 rows depending on scrolling. Action controls: two pill buttons placed in a horizontal row, centered above bottom safe area; each pill approx 150 pt width × 64 pt height, corner radius 32 pt for a capsule shape. Gap between pills ~16 pt. Cancel button: white background (#FBFBFB) with subtle inset shadow and dark label; Apply button: dark filled capsule using 0x3C3227 with white text. Both buttons sit on a soft elevated shadow: drop shadow rgba(60,50,39,0.12) or similar, blur 24–30 px, y-offset 8–12 px to create a floating look.

Borders, shadows, and states: disabled icons use no border and reduced opacity (approx 40–50%); active icon and preview use full opacity and full accent color. Buttons have distinct states: default (as described), pressed state should slightly reduce elevation and scale (0.98), and show a subtle color darken for the Apply pill. Hover states (if desktop) should slightly raise shadow and increase contrast. 

Micro-interactions & animation: tapping a grid icon animates a quick 120–180 ms ease-out transition: the tapped icon scales up slightly (1.15x) then transitions into the large preview via a crossfade/scale animation (scaled fade lasting 300 ms, easing: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)). When switching selection, the previously selected grid icon crossfades to grey while the new icon fills orange; preview updates with a brief pop (scale 1 → 1.06 → 1 with 200 ms). The Apply and Cancel buttons animate in from the bottom on screen entrance with 320 ms slide+fade easing. Disabled icons remain non-interactive and show pointer/gesture disabled state.

Accessibility & touch targets: grid icons have tappable hit targets of at least 44×44 pt; pills are 44+ pt tall and easy to tap. Contrast: primary dark Apply pill to white text passes contrast; pale grey icons are intentionally low-contrast as disabled elements. Provide accessible labels for each icon and VoiceOver support announcing selection and Apply/Cancel actions.
content.layout:
Single-screen vertical stack with three primary vertical zones: 1) Top status / preview zone — status bar at extreme top (time and system indicators), then a large centered preview icon (the selected pictogram) occupying the top third of the viewport. 2) Middle content zone — a uniform multi-column grid of small icons occupying the central area of the screen; the grid uses 5 equal columns with consistent rows. 3) Bottom action zone — two large capsule action buttons centered horizontally as a group, floating above the bottom safe area with drop shadow.

Columns & grouping: The grid uses 5 equal columns across the available content width (safe area width = viewport width minus 32 pt total horizontal margin). Each grid cell contains a single icon centered in its cell. The grid is a single group (one grid) with multiple row groups for visual organization; there is no left/right sidebar. The two action buttons are grouped as a single control cluster — centered and overlapping the lower portion of the grid (visually layered above with shadow). 

Grid details: Columns: 5. Rows: variable (6–8 visible + scroll). Cell size: ~56 pt square. Horizontal gap: ~20 pt; vertical gap: ~18–22 pt. Preview row: independent element positioned above the grid with significant breathing room (top margin ~36–56 pt). Buttons: a two-column cluster horizontally (two pills) centered as a single row, each pill one logical column in that cluster.
content.functions:
Specific actions: - Tap any icon in the grid to select it. When tapped the icon becomes active (fills with orange #E27305) and the large preview at the top updates to show the selected pictogram. - Scroll vertically through the grid to reveal additional icons (infinite/finite list). - Tap Cancel to dismiss the selection screen without saving changes (the Cancel pill is visually emphasized as a low-weight action; tapping triggers a dismissal animation). - Tap Apply to confirm the selected icon and close the selector, returning the chosen icon to the calling screen or saving it to the record.

Medium-level tasks / workflows: - Choose a pictogram to represent an item (for example a beverage type or category) by scanning the grid visually and tapping the matching silhouette. - Compare icons quickly via the large preview: selecting items updates the preview so users can verify the visual at a larger scale. - Make a final decision using the Apply or revert using Cancel; the UI provides immediate visual feedback on selection and a clear confirmation step so accidental picks can be avoided.

Broader goal: The interface is a dedicated icon-picker modal whose overall purpose is to let users pick and confirm a pictogram to represent a category, product, or profile item. It supports discoverability (visual grid), quick previewing (large preview), and safe confirmation (Apply/Cancel) to ensure clarity and reduce errors. The layout and visual cues prioritize quick scanning and one-tap selection with clear confirmation.

content.description:
Overall style and purpose
- Minimal, iOS-style selection screen for choosing a pictogram/emoji-like icon from a catalogue. Clean, high-white background with subdued grey placeholders and a single high-contrast selected icon shown in large scale above the grid. Two prominent pill-shaped action buttons (Cancel / Apply) float above the bottom with soft, large shadows. Visual language is flat with subtle depth via large soft shadows and very simple filled icon shapes.

Color palette (use exact HEX provided)
- Primary selected color (orange): #E07307 (used for the currently selected icon and small accent on its straw/top area). 
- Dark action button background / text primary: #3C3227 (used for dark button background or text on white button). 
- Secondary blue (not visibly dominant on this screen but included in palette provided): #0474E4 (available as brand/interactive color). 
- Page background / near-white: #FBFBFB (overall canvas). 
- Light grey / placeholders: #E2E3DD (used for the faded/unselected icons and subtle UI elements).

Typography
- System font: SF Pro (iOS system) or equivalent. 
- Primary action label (“Apply”): SF Pro Display / SF Pro Text - Semibold, ~18–20pt, white on dark pill. Letter spacing normal/0. 
- Secondary action label (“Cancel”): SF Pro Text - Semibold, ~18–20pt, #3C3227 on white pill. 
- Large header time/status uses iOS system small text at top left (status bar native styling). 
- All labels center-aligned inside pills. Line-height ~22–24pt for 18–20pt text.

Layout and spacing (assumes an iPhone 375pt width baseline; use density-independent pts)
- Safe area / top status: 44pt reserved (status bar with left time and right system indicators). 
- Large selected icon preview: centered horizontally near the top third of the screen. Visual size ~120–140pt tall, with small internal highlight/white stroke detail on top. Vertical distance from top safe area ~40–60pt. 
- Icon grid area: begins ~220–260pt from top (below the large preview) and fills central vertical space down toward the bottom. The grid is 5 columns across. 
  - Grid cell size (icon bounding box): ~56–64pt square. 
  - Icon glyph size inside cell: ~34–40pt (centered). 
  - Horizontal gutter between columns: ~18–22pt. 
  - Vertical gutter between rows: ~22–28pt. 
  - Grid rows visible on screen: ~6–7 rows (the screenshot shows many rows; the content is scrollable). 
- Selected icon in the grid (secondary selection state) is colored #E07307 (filled) while all other grid icons are very light grey #E2E3DD with ~18–24% opacity to appear faded. 
- Bottom action bar (floating): two rounded pill buttons horizontally centered, sitting just above the bottom safe area. 
  - Each pill button dimensions: width ~150–170pt, height ~66–72pt, corner radius ~36pt (capsule). 
  - Spacing between pills: ~22–24pt. 
  - Pills are visually elevated with a large soft shadow: drop shadow color rgba(60,50,39,0.12), blur ~28–40pt, offset y ~10–14pt. 
  - Left pill: white background (#FBFBFB), border none (subtle inner shadow), text color #3C3227 semibold. 
  - Right pill: dark fill #3C3227, text white semibold. 
- Overall horizontal padding of content: ~20–24pt from screen edge.

UI elements and iconography
- Icons are simplified filled silhouettes (no strokes), consistent corner radii and simplified shapes (bottles, cups, glasses). Unselected icons rendered as single-color pale grey (#E2E3DD) at low contrast. The selected icon is the same glyph but filled in #E07307 and slightly larger in the top preview.
- Large preview is the same glyph scaled up, vertically centered in the top area with small white decorative stroke detail near the top of the icon.

States and interactions
- Tap on any small grey icon: it animates into selected state — small scale up (~1.06x), color transitions to #E07307, and the large preview above animates to that glyph (cross-fade or morph). The tapped cell briefly elevates with soft shadow. 
- Unselected icons are low-contrast and do not respond to taps beyond selection feedback. 
- The Apply button is enabled when an icon is selected; Cancel always available. Disabled state (if implemented) would be a lower-contrast dark button with 40% opacity. 
- Buttons provide press animations: fast scale down to ~0.98 over 60ms then spring back (easing: cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1)). 
- Grid is vertically scrollable; big preview stays pinned at top (not fixed to header but remains visible while scrolling icons). 

Accessibility notes
- Ensure 44pt minimum tap targets for each icon and both pill buttons. Provide VoiceOver labels for each glyph (e.g., “Milk bottle icon”), and ensure contrast for text on buttons meets WCAG minimum (white on #3C3227 is sufficient; grey text on white pill is borderline — ensure heavier weight or slightly darker text if needed).
content.layout:
Overall structure
- Full-bleed single column canvas with centered content.
- Top area: status bar (native) + large preview icon centered horizontally. This top area acts like a header/hero for the selected glyph. 
- Middle area: an evenly spaced icon grid (5 columns). The grid forms the main interactive body and is vertically scrollable. Grid items are regular, same-sized cells arranged in columns and rows.
- Bottom area: floating horizontal action cluster with two pill buttons centered horizontally. Buttons slightly overlap the lowest portion of the grid and cast large shadows to indicate elevation.

Grid details
- Column count: 5 columns. 
- Grouping: single grid group (no nested columns). All icons belong to the same catalogue group. 
- Row count visible on screenshot: about 6–7 rows, full catalogue likely many more rows accessible via scroll. 
- Alignment: grid cells horizontally centered within the screen content area with equal left-right margins. Each icon is centered inside its cell. 

Key layout metrics (approximations)
- Top safe area: 44pt. 
- Hero icon top offset: ~48pt from safe area. 
- Grid left/right margin: ~20–24pt. 
- Cell size: ~56–64pt with ~18–24pt gutters. 
- Bottom pill cluster: buttons width ~150–170pt each, height ~66–72pt, capsule corner radius ~36pt, center aligned with ~22pt spacing between them, bottom offset ~20–28pt above safe area.

- vertical-scroll

content.functions:
Specific actions (micro interactions)
- Tap an icon thumbnail: selects that glyph and immediately updates the large preview at the top to show the chosen glyph in primary orange (#E07307). The tapped thumbnail briefly grows and receives fuller opacity to indicate selection. 
- Scroll the grid: vertically scroll through available glyphs (grid supports multiple pages/rows). 
- Tap Cancel: dismisses the selector without saving changes (close or pop). Visual feedback: press animation on white pill and may trigger a close transition (fade/slide down). 
- Tap Apply: confirms the selected icon and returns the selected glyph to the caller/context. Visual feedback: press animation on dark pill then a confirmation transition (dismiss with short scale/fade or navigate back).
- Preview update: tapping a different glyph swaps the large preview immediately, giving instant visual confirmation of selection.

Medium-level tasks (flows)
- Browse & pick an icon for a profile, product, or item category: user scrolls grid, inspects each glyph in the small thumbnails and in the larger preview, then taps Apply to commit. The layout emphasizes preview so users can compare glyphs at a larger scale before confirming. 
- Cancel flow: user can abandon selection and keep previous icon (Cancel closes modal without saving). 
- Scrolling & discovery: the grid supports quick scanning of silhouettes; frequent categories appear early, with all items shown as a continuous scroll list.

Broader purpose (goal achieved through this screen)
- The screen is a dedicated icon/pictogram selector used to customize an item’s visual representation (for example: choosing a drink icon, category icon, or avatar). It facilitates fast visual selection with immediate large-scale preview and clear apply/cancel actions so users can confidently choose and confirm an icon with minimal friction. The design ensures clarity by using strong contrast for the selected state, low-contrast placeholders for all other options, and large, easily tappable confirm controls.

content.description:
Overview
- Single-column, scrollable “edit item” screen for customizing a product (looks like a beverage). The layout is a vertical stack of large rounded rectangular list items (cards/tiles) on a very light background. Each row contains: a small monochrome icon at the left, a bold label, and a right-aligned value or control (text, small icon, or colored dot). There are subtle section separators (thin horizontal hairlines) dividing groups of rows. Top-left and top-right floating pill buttons provide Cancel and Save actions.

Color palette (use these exact HEX values):
- Page background: #FBFBFB (very light gray)
- Primary dark (text/icons, primary CTA background): #3D3127 (deep brown/dark slate)
- Muted text / secondary: #9FA1A5 (cool grey) — used for placeholder/secondary values
- Accent / warm: #B26B49 (orange / brown accent) — used for small highlights (e.g., caffeine mg label or decorative elements)
- Accent / blue: #0A74E1 (bright blue) — used for positive/interactive value (e.g., hydration percentage)
- Row surface (card background): #FFFFFF (pure white) with very soft shadow (see shadows)
- Interactive color swatch (dot): vivid orange #F07A00 (approx; derived from screenshot — can use #B26B49 for brand accent if needed)
- Divider hairline: rgba(61,49,39,0.06) or #E9E9E9
- Save button text: #FBFBFB (white)

Typography
- Font family: SF Pro / Inter (system sans-serif). Use SF Pro Text where possible for iOS feel.
- Label (row title): 18px, 600 (semibold), letter-spacing 0, color #3D3127, line-height ~24px, left-aligned inside each row.
- Value (right-side descriptive text): 16px, 500 (medium), color #9FA1A5 for placeholders, or colored per value (hydration uses #0A74E1, caffeine uses #B26B49, alcohol uses purple/indigo #6B57D9 or similar). Right-aligned vertically center.
- Small hint/inactive label (e.g., placeholder value on Name): 16px, 500, color #C7C9CC (use #9FA1A5 at 60% opacity for subdued values).
- Top action text (Cancel): 14px, 600, color #3D3127 on a light pill; Save text: 14px, 700, color #FBFBFB.

Row / Card styles
- Each row is a full-width rounded rectangle card spanning nearly full width with horizontal margin/safe area: left/right safe padding 20–24 px from the device edge. Card width = screen width - 40 to 48 px.
- Card background: #FFFFFF (white). Corner radius: 22 px (rounded pill-like). Card height: ~64–72 px depending on content. Internal horizontal padding: 20 px left, 20 px right. Vertical padding to center content.
- Shadow: very soft drop shadow for each card: 0 6px 12px rgba(61,49,39,0.04) to give subtle elevation.
- Left icon: monochrome stroke icon, 24 x 24 px, stroke width 2 px, color #3D3127. Icon is vertically centered and sits 18 px from left card edge.
- Label text: placed to the right of icon with 12–14 px spacing. Label baseline vertically centered.
- Right-side value area: right-aligned within card, vertically center. Values may be plain text, small glyph/emoji icon, or a circular color swatch (12–14 px diameter). Value text color varies by semantic meaning (muted vs accent colors as described above).
- Rows are separated by 16–22 px vertical spacing between cards. In two places a thin centered divider (hairline) is used as section separation — width ~48–80 px, height 2 px, color #EDEDED, horizontally centered with top/bottom margins 18–24 px.

Top bar actions
- Cancel: left floating pill button placed inside the safe area, overlapping slightly into content area. Pill size ~84 x 38 px, background = #FFFFFF with subtle inner shadow or light outline; text = CAPS, 14px 600, color #3D3127.
- Save: right floating pill button with solid fill color #3D3127, text = white, size ~84 x 38 px, border-radius 20 px. Drop shadow similar to cards but slightly stronger.
- Both pills have 12 px internal horizontal padding and are vertically aligned to the top of the content area (approx 16–18 px from top safe area). They sit on top of the first card area visually (overlap) as in screenshot.

Specific rows (top to bottom)
- 1) Name row: left tag icon, label 'Name' (18px semibold), right-side value 'Pumpkin Latte' in muted grey #9FA1A5 indicating editable text field. Tapping opens a text input modal or inline keyboard.
- 2) Size row: left ruler icon, label 'Size', right text '15oz' in muted grey (#9FA1A5).
- (thin centered divider)
- 3) Icon row: left icon crop/choose icon, label 'Icon', right small product glyph (orange drink illustration) sized ~28 px as a thumbnail.
- 4) Color row: left palette icon, label 'Color', right small circular dot (12–14 px) filled with the selected color (orange). The color swatch has a subtle border (1px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)) and drop shadow.
- 5) Animation row: left bubbles icon, label 'Animation', right text 'Micro Bubbles' in muted grey #9FA1A5.
- (thin centered divider)
- 6) Hydration row: left droplet icon, label 'Hydration', right text '70%' colored #0A74E1 (bright blue) indicating a positive metric. Could also be an editable numeric slider on interaction.
- 7) Caffeine row: left coffee bean icon, label 'Caffeine', right text '75mg' colored #B26B49 (warm brown) or #3D3127 depending on emphasis.
- 8) Alcohol row: left martini icon, label 'Alcohol', right small text 'No' in muted indigo/purple (#6B57D9) indicating none.

Input states & interactions
- Tapping a row enters a detail selection view or opens a modal / sheet to edit that field. Selected rows show a subtle highlight state: right-side value color becomes accent color, left icon may change to accent.
- Name editing: standard on-screen keyboard appears; input field should show caret and underline only in the editing modal, not inside the list card.
- Color row opens a color picker swatch modal with preview and OK/Cancel actions.
- Icon row opens a gallery of icons (grid) with the chosen icon appearing in the right side of the card as a thumbnail.
- Hydration/Caffeine rows may open numeric pickers or sliders; while the list shows current value as text.

Micro-interactions / animations
- Row tap: fast elevation animation (150–200ms) with ease-out-cubic and a small scale or shadow increase for tactile feedback.
- Save / Cancel: fast fade + slide confirmation (200ms). When saving, show a success toast or subtle success animation.
- Color swatch changes should animate the swatch fill with a 180ms ease-out color transition.

Accessibility
- High-contrast label colors (dark text #3D3127) with minimum 4.5:1 contrast to background.
- Tap targets: each row minimum 44 x 44 px active area.
- All icons have accessible labels; values readable by VoiceOver.

Measurements (approximate, to reproduce proportions)
- Screen safe horizontal inset: 20 px
- Row height: 68 px
- Row corner radius: 22 px
- Left icon size: 24 x 24 px, left gap 18 px
- Label left margin from icon: 12 px
- Right value right margin: 18 px
- Vertical spacing between cards: 16–20 px
- Divider (centered): width 56 px, height 2 px, margin vertical 20 px
- Top safe area: 44 px; top pill vertical offset from top: ~8–12 px

Overall style
- Modern iOS-style minimalism with rounded “squircle” cards, soft shadows, and restrained color accents. Visual language focuses on large touch targets, clear hierarchy (bold left label, lighter right value), and pill-shaped CTA buttons that float above content.
content.layout:
Overall layout
- Single-column stacked layout (one main column). No multi-column areas.
- The screen content is grouped into three logical groups separated by central thin dividers: (1) top group: Name, Size; (2) middle group: Icon, Color, Animation; (3) bottom group: Hydration, Caffeine, Alcohol.

Columns / groups
- Column count: 1 primary column.
- Groups: 3 groups (Top group = 2 rows; Middle group = 3 rows; Bottom group = 3 rows). Each group visually separated by a centered hairline divider (~56 px wide) and extra vertical spacing.

Grid / row structure
- Each group uses a simple row grid with 8 total rows overall. Rows are uniform in width and height (consistent card design), forming a single-column grid with 8 rows and implicit row height ~68 px.

Alignment & spacing
- Left-aligned icon and label column; right-aligned value column. Horizontal gutters: left/right safe insets ~20 px. Inter-element spacing: icon-to-label = 12 px; label-to-value flexible space; value-to-edge = 18 px.
- Visual rhythm is consistent: each row’s vertical center aligns across the column. Divider spacing above/below ~20 px.

- right-value-alignment

content.functions:
Specific actions (what users can do on this screen)
- Tap the 'Name' row to open a text edit field (keyboard) and update the product name. The right-side value shows current name and becomes an editable text field in the editor.
- Tap the 'Size' row to choose from predefined size options (e.g., 8oz / 12oz / 15oz) via a list, wheel picker, or modal.
- Tap the 'Icon' row to open an icon gallery or asset selector; selecting an icon updates the thumbnail shown on the right of the row.
- Tap the 'Color' row to open a color picker modal or swatch palette; choosing a swatch updates the small color dot on the row.
- Tap the 'Animation' row to select from animation presets (e.g., Micro Bubbles). Selection updates the right-side text.
- Tap the 'Hydration' row to enter or adjust a numeric value or percentage (could be edited via number entry, slider, or segmented control). The list displays the chosen percentage in blue.
- Tap the 'Caffeine' row to input a numeric mg value (e.g., 75mg) via number input; displayed value uses accent color for emphasis.
- Tap the 'Alcohol' row to toggle or select between options (Yes/No) or pick alcohol content values. The current state displays as 'No' or a numeric value.
- Use the 'Cancel' pill to discard any unsaved changes; the action likely dismisses the editor.
- Use the 'Save' pill to persist all changes; tapping Save triggers a saving flow (visual confirmation: spinner or toast) and returns to the previous screen.

Medium-level tasks / workflows
- Edit single attribute: open its row, adjust value in the modal or inline control, confirm to return to list showing updated value.
- Bulk edit: make several changes across multiple rows and then tap Save to commit all changes in a single transaction.
- Visual preview flow: changing Icon/Color/Animation provides immediate visual feedback in the row and (optionally) in a small preview area in the modal.

Broader purpose
- The screen serves as an item editor / product customizer where the user configures properties of a beverage or similar product template (name, size, icon, color, animation, and nutritional/behavioral metadata like hydration, caffeine, alcohol). It is designed for quick scanning and easy selection with large touch targets and clear affordances, enabling users to efficiently create or edit a product and persist changes with Save or discard with Cancel.

content.description:
High-level overview
- Purpose: A full-screen mobile color selection interface with a large live-preview illustration at top and a rounded white control card in the lower half. The control card contains preset circular swatches, a custom-color add control, three horizontal sliders (hue, saturation/opacity-like, lightness/brightness-like), and two large pill-style action buttons (Cancel and Apply) that overlap the bottom edge of the card.

Overall visual style

- Background: Solid white (#FFFFFF). The page header (status bar) uses black/very-dark text for time and system icons.

Top preview
- Illustration: Large single-color flat vector illustration (a goblet / trophy-like shape) centered near the top. Illustration fill color matches the currently selected color (in screenshot it is orange). Illustration is visually sized to occupy roughly the top third of the screen and centered horizontally.
- Title: The word "Color" sits directly below the illustration, horizontally centered. Typeface is a rounded humanist sans — use SF Pro Display or Inter (semibold/medium). Suggested styling: 28pt, 600 weight, letter spacing 0, color Dark Slate (#2B3946 or use provided 0x3C332B for a dark brownish tone). Vertical spacing between illustration and title ~24–28 px.

Control card (rounded sheet)

The card has an inner padding of ~22–28 px and is slightly elevated with a soft shadow: e.g., box-shadow: 0 18px 30px rgba(60,51,43,0.08) plus a smaller inner shadow for depth. The card width is ~86% of screen width with about 20–24 px margin on each horizontal side.
- Card background is near-white with a very subtle grey tint (#FAFBFC or #F7F8F9) to separate it from page white.

Preset swatches
- Grid: Two rows of five circular color swatches aligned in a centered grid. Each swatch is a solid circle 44–52 px diameter, spaced horizontally with ~16–20 px between centers and vertically ~18–20 px between rows.
- Colors (approx hex values observed): light gray #E6E8EA, yellow #FFD400, orange #F6A000 (selected in preview), pink #FFB6DA, red #E93A5E, green #74E07B, cyan/aqua #00C7E6, violet #7C4DFF, brown #7A4736, dark charcoal #2B333C. (Use the product palette + developer-specified main colors: 0x3C332B, 0xE3504C, 0x097AE6, 0x3CDFA2, 0xE2BF10.)
- Selected state: The currently selected swatch shows a thick dark ring/border (approx 4–6 px) in dark navy/charcoal (#222A33 or 0x3C332B) and an internal orange check icon (white check on orange circle or orange circle with white check depending on style). Unselected swatches have no border or a very thin translucent border.

Custom color / add control
- Beneath the presets and separated by a light hairline divider is a small row containing: (1) a circular preview of the current custom color selection with a check or indicator (same selected style as presets), and (2) a lighter circular “+” button to add/save a custom swatch. Each circle approx 44 px diameter, spaced ~18 px apart. The add button is light grey (#EFEFF0) with a subtle inner shadow and a centered plus icon (stroke #999).

Sliders
- There are three full-width horizontal sliders stacked vertically with even spacing:
  1) Hue slider (top): a slim track (~8–10 px high) showing a full rainbow gradient left-to-right (red → yellow → green → cyan → blue → magenta → red). The thumb is a circular knob ~20–24 px diameter colored with an accent (orange in screenshot). Thumb has a small shadow and an outer white or dark stroke to separate it from track.
  2) Middle slider: a soft gradient likely controlling saturation or tint — in screenshot it’s a pale peach → orange gradient. Track height ~10–12 px, rounded. Thumb matches accent orange and sits on right side.
  3) Bottom slider: a darker brown/orange gradient representing brightness/value or a second parameter (maybe warmth/darken). Track similar height. Thumb appears as filled orange circle.
- Sliders have subtle track background contrasted by colorful gradient fill. The active portion to the left of the thumb can be slightly elevated or darker; however the screenshot shows full gradient and a round thumb overlay.
- Spacing: Sliders spaced ~14–20 px vertically from each other and from the swatch area.

Action buttons
- Two pill-shaped action buttons overlap and sit in front of the bottom edge of the card. They are horizontally centered as a pair with small gap and appear slightly floating with larger drop shadows.
  - Left: "Cancel" pill — white fill (#FFFFFF) with subtle inner shadow/ring; text in dark charcoal (#2B333C or 0x3C332B), font semibold 18pt. Pill size approx 140px wide x 64px high, corner radius ~32px.
  - Right: "Apply" pill — dark charcoal/blue fill (#222A33 or 0x3C332B), text in white, semibold 18pt. Same size as Cancel. The Apply pill has a stronger drop shadow (e.g., 0 20px 30px rgba(34,42,51,0.15)). The right pill sits slightly above/overlapping the left pill to create depth.
- Buttons provide visual affordance (e.g., pressed state: slight inset shadow; disabled state: lower opacity).

Spacing & grid summary
- Full-screen vertical layout with three main vertical blocks: preview illustration (~top 33%), title (~5–7%), control card (~lower 55%). The control card contains grid of swatches (two rows x five columns), custom controls row (two circular buttons), three sliders, and action buttons overlapping the bottom.
- Typical paddings: outer page horizontal margin 20–24 px; control card padding 20–28 px; swatch-to-sw arch spacing ~16–20 px.

Typography
- Primary font: SF Pro Display or Inter (system iOS sans). Title: 28px–32px, weight semibold (600). Body/action text: 16–18px, 600 for buttons, 400–500 for labels. Color for main text and icons: dark charcoal (#2B333C or 0x3C332B).

Icons & graphics
- Use simple filled vector shapes for swatches and illustration. Check icon is a small 12–14 px white check inside the selected swatch. The add icon is a simple 2px stroke plus sign.

Shadows & elevation
- Card shadow: soft, large blur radius with low opacity to separate from background (e.g., 0 24px 40px rgba(60,50,40,0.06)). Action buttons have stronger shadow for lift.

Interaction & animations
- Micro interactions: When user taps a swatch the preview illustration instantly updates (200ms fade+color-morph). Slider handles animate smoothly with easing cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1) and animation duration ~160–220ms.
- Selected swatch transition: ring expands from 0 to full (scale animation 80%→100%) with 160ms ease.
- Button press: quick scale down (0.98) and shadow reduction.

Accessibility
- Ensure 44px minimum touch target for all tappable elements (swatches, add, slider handles). Provide contrast for text on action buttons (WCAG AA/AAA as possible). Provide descriptive labels for screen readers (e.g., "Hue slider, value 45%", "Select color orange").

- Major sections (top to bottom): 1) Status bar area (system indicators). 2) Large preview illustration centered. 3) Title text centered. 4) Rounded control card (occupying lower half) containing presets, custom controls, sliders, and overlapping action buttons.

  5) Bottom area: action buttons visually anchored to the card bottom but actually overlapping it and floating above the page background. They are horizontally centered with a small gap between the two pills.

Columns & alignment

- Groups: two main groups in the card — the color-selection group (swatches + custom controls) and the adjustments group (sliders + actions).

Spacing & sizes

content.functions:
Specific actions (micro-level)
- Tap a preset circular color swatch to immediately select that color — the selected swatch gets a thick dark ring and a check indicator.
- Tap the circular + button to add a custom color to the preset list (or open extended custom color panel).
- Drag the top slider horizontally to change hue; the slider shows a full-spectrum gradient as visual affordance.
- Drag the middle slider to adjust saturation/tint/opacity (visualized by a peach/orange gradient).
- Drag the bottom slider to adjust brightness/darken/warmth (visualized by a brown/orange gradient).
- Tap "Cancel" to dismiss without applying changes; tap "Apply" to confirm and apply selected color to whatever object is being edited.

Medium-level tasks (workflows)
- Create a custom color: use hue slider to pick a base hue, adjust middle slider for saturation/intensity, adjust bottom slider for warmth or darkness; then press + to save the custom swatch into the top presets area.
- Quickly pick a preset: select one of the visible swatches and press Apply to set the color immediately.
- Compare before/after: the preview illustration at the top updates in real time as adjustments are made so the user can evaluate the color before applying.

High-level purpose
- The screen’s overall goal is to allow the user to choose and fine-tune a color to apply to an object or theme in the app (customization). It packages both quick choices (preset swatches) and fine-grained control (three sliders) so users of different needs can achieve a color they want quickly and confirm or cancel the change. Visual feedback (large preview) and clear primary actions (Apply/Cancel) ensure the user can evaluate and commit their choice with confidence.

content.description:
Single-screen mobile color picker presented as a centered vertical flow with a large product/preview illustration at the top, a title, and a rounded, elevated selection card (bottom sheet style) that contains color swatches, a custom color row, three horizontal sliders, and two large pill CTAs overlapping the bottom of the card. Overall style: minimal, soft shadows, heavy use of rounded corners and circles, playful modern rounded sans typography (similar to SF Pro / Inter Rounded). Visual hierarchy: large preview illustration (cup) at top center (~200–260 px tall), then a single-line title centered below (“Color”), then the rounded white card occupying the bottom ~60% of the screen with 24–32 px corner radius and a subtle outer shadow.

Color palette (primary & UI colors found in the screenshot and developer-supplied palette):
- Background: white #FFFFFF
- Card background (very subtle gray): #F6F7F8 (approx)
- Main preview/illustration teal: #2DD1BC (developer provided) shown as the large cup graphic
- Dark text / primary CTA background: #403830 (developer provided dark brown used for deep dark elements) or a near-navy used for the Apply button; use #222B33 for text if reproducing
- Accent bright olive/khaki: #8E8640 (developer provided)
- Accent pink/magenta: #E23C78 (developer provided)
- Accent strong blue: #2345E5 (developer provided)
- Swatches include clear saturated colors: light grey (#E9ECEF), yellow (#FFD400), orange (#FF9900), light pink (#FFB6E0), red (#E51A4C), green (#6CE07B), cyan (#00C8D9), purple (#7B5CFF), brown (#6F3F2F), dark slate (#2B3138) — reproduce as saturated circular chips.
- Shadows: rgba(36,45,56,0.10) for soft card shadow; deeper button shadow rgba(36,45,56,0.16).

Typography (recommended to match look):
- Heading “Color”: font-family: SF Pro Display / Inter; size: 28px; weight: 600 (semibold); line-height: 34px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: center; color: #2B3A43 (dark slate).
- Button labels: 18–20px; weight: 600; center aligned.
- Small helper / none present; sliders have no visible numeric labels in screenshot.

Card and components:
- Card container: centered horizontally, max-width around 86% of screen width on phone, background #F6F7F8, border-radius: 28px; padding: top 22px, horizontal 18–22px, bottom 88px (to allow buttons to overlap); drop shadow subtle.
- Swatch grid: two rows of five circular swatches (5 columns x 2 rows). Each swatch: diameter 44–52 px, margin/gap around 14–18 px horizontally and vertically. Swatches are perfectly circular with no border; selected swatch shows a circular dark ring and a white check icon centered.
- Divider: thin horizontal hairline centered under swatches, color #E6E9EB, margin vertical 14–18 px.
- Custom row: three circular slots (left shows selected custom color circle with accent ring + check, middle is an “add” empty circular control with a “+” and subtle border color #E6E9EB, right is another swatch slot in the screenshot — layout is three items spaced evenly). Circle diameter similar to swatches; selected custom has a concentric ring (outer dark ring ~4–6 px) and an inner check.

Sliders (three stacked):
- Each slider occupies full width minus horizontal padding. Track height ~10–12 px with strongly rounded ends. Each track is a gradient: first = rainbow gradient (red→yellow→green→cyan→blue→magenta→red); second = pale cyan-to-light-blue to represent saturation/brightness (soft gradient #E6FBFF → #74E0FF); third = dark teal to bright cyan gradient (#003A42 → #00C8D9) representing value or contrast.
- Thumb: circular knob diameter ~26–32 px, filled with the current preview color (or teal), thin white border 2 px, slight shadow. When active (dragging), thumb slightly scales to 1.08 and casts a deeper shadow. Default thumb position shows different x offsets per slider.
- Spacing between sliders ~18 px.

Buttons (bottom, overlapping card):
- Two pill buttons horizontally aligned, centered, slightly overlapping / floating above the bottom edge of the card. Left: “Cancel” — white fill, subtle inner shadow, text color dark slate (#2B3A43). Right: “Apply” — dark fill (near #2B3138 or developer 0x403830), white text. Both buttons: width ~140–160 px, height ~64 px, border-radius 34–36 px, font-weight 600, font-size 18–20 px. Buttons cast soft drop shadows matching card.

Icons & small UI details:
- Check icon in selected swatch: white check mark (stroke width approx 3 px) centered.
- “+” add button: circular pale button (#EDEFF1) with a faint plus symbol centered.
- Status bar at top with time and phone indicators; top safe area respected.

Spacing & alignment:
- Entire layout is single-column and vertically center-aligned. Horizontal center line runs through cup illustration, title, and card. Use consistent 20 px baseline spacing between major blocks (illustration → title → card content).

Micro-interactions & animations (recommended to replicate behavior):
- Opening the card: upward slide with ease-out cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) over 320ms and small scale of content.
- Swatch select: quick scale-down/scale-up micro-interaction (80%→100%) with a 140ms ease to indicate selection; check appears with fade/scale.
- Slider drag: real-time preview update of the cup illustration; thumb movement follows finger with 0ms lag; on release, a small bounce easing (cubic-bezier .34,1.56, .64,1).
- Buttons: press states produce subtle inner shadow and 0.96 scale.

Notes for recreation:
- Use a single-column mobile artboard ~375x812 pts for accurate spacing.
- Pay attention to generous radii (rounded theme) and the layered soft shadows to achieve the lifted “card + floating pills” aesthetic.
- Provide live preview binding from sliders to illustration color so the preview updates fluidly as sliders move.

content.functions:
Specific actions (micro-level):
- Tap a color swatch: immediately selects that preset color and updates the preview illustration; selected swatch shows a dark circular outline and a white check mark.
- Tap the custom '+' slot: opens a mechanism to save the currently composed color into a custom slot (or opens a larger color control for precise input) — represented as a circular add control.
- Drag each of the three sliders: adjust color attributes (hue, saturation, brightness/value or similar) and update the preview in real time. The top slider is a full-hue rainbow (choose base hue), the middle adjusts saturation/tones, the bottom adjusts darkness/value.
- Tap the preview illustration: (not explicit in screenshot, but could optionally cycle between preview states or confirm selection).
- Tap Cancel: dismiss the bottom sheet without applying changes (animated slide-down and revert preview to previous color).
- Tap Apply: confirm and persist the chosen color; saves selection and closes the bottom sheet. Visual feedback: brief success micro-animation (e.g., pulse on the preview cup) then close.

Medium-level workflows:

Broader goals:

The screen is designed for clarity and speed — presets for quick choice, sliders for fine control, visible preview for immediate validation, and strong primary CTA to persist the change.

content.description:
Overview
- Full-screen, single-column mobile edit screen for a single item (a drink/ product). Light, airy aesthetic with lots of white space and soft rounded cards stacked vertically. Top status area shows time and system icons; below that a header-level area contains two pill actions: a left "CANCEL" pill (light background, subtle border/shadow) and a right dark "SAVE" pill (contrasting fill). The content is a sequence of full-width rounded cards (rows) each representing an editable attribute.
Color palette (primary colors observed)
- Background / page base: #FBFBFB (very pale gray / off-white)
- Primary text / icon color (dark): #3D3127 (deep desaturated brown/dark slate)
- Accent gold / brand highlight (used occasionally): #A0923B
- Neutral gray (secondary text / disabled): #A0A0A1
- Brown accent (value color for caffeine): #A26960
- Additional observed accents (approximations): teal/cyan for hydration value (#00C8D8), deep teal/blue for icon thumbnail (#2F7F84), purple for "No" alcohol indicator (#6F66E0)
- Card surface color: very slightly off-white (almost #FFFFFF with subtle warm tint) with faint drop shadow (approx rgba(61,49,39,0.03) or rgba(0,0,0,0.04)).
Typography
- Typeface style resembles a system rounded sans (e.g., SF Pro Text / Inter with rounded feel). Use hierarchical weights:
  - Row label (left, e.g., "Name", "Size", "Icon"): ~17–18px, Medium/Semi-Bold (600), letter-spacing 0.0–0.2px, color #3D3127
  - Row value (right, e.g., "Pumpkin Latte", "15oz", "Micro Bubbles"): ~15–16px, Regular (400) or Medium 500 for emphasis, color #A0A0A1 for tertiary or colored accents for value (teal/brown/purple)
  - Micro copy (if present): 13–14px, Regular, color #A0A0A1
- Line height: ~20–24px for labels, ~18–22px for values
Layout & grid
- Single column layout (one vertical stack). All content centered horizontally with side margins.
- Screen width assumed ~375–390pt usable (iPhone-style). Each card spans nearly full width with horizontal inner padding ~20–24pt.
- Row / card count: visible rows in this screenshot ~9 (Name, Size, divider, Icon, Color, Animation, divider, Hydration, Caffeine, Alcohol) — two soft dividers separate groups.
Row / card details
- Card container
  - Shape: fully rounded rectangle (pill-like) with large corner radius ~18–24pt
  - Height: ~64–84pt per row (approx 72pt typical). Taller rows when there is an icon thumbnail on the right.
  - Background: slightly off-white or very light gray against page background (subtle contrast)
  - Padding: left padding ~20–24px; right padding ~20–24px; vertical padding ~16–20px
  - Shadow: subtle outer shadow to lift cards slightly (very soft, blur ~10–16px, opacity ~0.03–0.06)
- Row content arrangement
  - Left: small line icon inside the card (stroke line icon representing the attribute). Icon size ~22–28px, stroke weight ~2–3px, color #3D3127.
  - Next to icon: label text (e.g., "Name", "Size", "Icon") aligned vertically center.
  - Right: value text or small control/thumbnail aligned vertically center (e.g., value text in gray or colored; an icon thumbnail for Icon row; a circular color swatch for Color row).
  - Many rows display a subtle right-side affordance (value text, a small thumbnail or dot) rather than explicit chevron.
- Separators
  - Thin horizontal hairline separators (~1px), light gray (#EDEDED or slightly darker), used between logical groups. They are short and centered horizontally, not full-width.\nTop actions
- Cancel (left) pill
  - Small pill with light background (very subtle tint), text "CANCEL" in uppercase and muted gray (#A0A0A1), medium weight. Soft shadow or slight inset to separate from background.
- Save (right) pill
  - Dark filled pill (rounded), text "SAVE" white or pale, bold. Size ~64x36px, corner radius half height ~18px. Strong contrast to attract primary action.
Icons & imagery
- All icons are line icons with consistent stroke weight and rounded corners. Left-side icons visually indicate attribute meaning (tag for Name, ruler for Size, paint palette for Color, droplet for Hydration, coffee bean for Caffeine, martini glass for Alcohol).
- Right-side thumbnail on Icon row is a small filled illustration / motif that gives a preview. Color swatch is a filled small circle (~14–18px diameter) for Color row. Value text uses colored accents to visually communicate (teal for hydration, brown for caffeine, purple for alcohol/no).
Interactions & states
- Rows behave as tappable controls; hovering or tapping shows subtle highlight. Typical interactions:
  - Tapping Name opens keyboard/text field to edit string; inline or push navigation.
  - Tapping Size opens a picker (modal/wheel) or selection list.
  - Tapping Icon opens an icon picker grid.
  - Tapping Color opens color picker or palette; the circular swatch updates.
  - Tapping Animation opens a selection view; current selection shown as right-side text.
  - Tapping Hydration/Caffeine opens numeric inputs or sliders to adjust values.
- Save triggers validation and a subtle success toast or modal; Cancel discards changes and navigates back.
Spacing & rhythm
- Vertical spacing between cards ~12–18px.
- Left icon-to-label gap ~12–14px.
- Label-to-value flexible space uses left-aligned label and right-aligned value with auto layout behavior.
Motion & animation
- Micro-interactions are subtle: tap feedback (scale or opacity change, 120–160ms), save success uses short fade-in toast (200–300ms) and slight upward motion.
Accessibility
- High contrast on primary action (Save). Text sizes for primary labels large enough (~17–18pt). Tap targets appear to be >=44x44pt.
Overall style
- Minimal, soft, modern iOS-inspired product-edit form. Uses gentle shadows, large rounded cards, left-aligned icons, and right-aligned concise values to create a calm, scannable list of editable attributes. Visual emphasis is on clarity and rapid scanning rather than dense data input.
content.layout:
Overall structure
- Single-column vertical stack containing repeating row cards. There are two logical groups separated by short horizontal dividers: (1) identity and visual attributes (Name, Size, Icon, Color, Animation) and (2) functional metrics (Hydration, Caffeine, Alcohol).
Columns & grouping
- Columns: 1 main content column.
- Row groups: 2 groups (visual/identity group, metrics group) separated by hairline separators. Each row is a group of three implicit subcolumns: icon column (left), label column (center-left), value/control column (right).
Row / grid details
- Rows per visible screen: ~9 rows including header action row. Each row measured as one repeated tile in a vertical list.
- Grid: not a rectangular grid; it’s a vertical list (one column). There are no nested columns beyond the icon/label/value structure inside each row.
Alignment & spacing
- Horizontal alignment: cards centered to device edges with consistent left/right padding (~20–24px). Icon and label aligned to left within the card content area; values aligned flush to the right side of the card.
- Vertical rhythm: equal heights for rows with consistent vertical spacing between them (~12–18px). Large corner radii create pill-like rows.
Keywords to describe layout
- single-column
- vertical-list
- rounded-cards
- left-icon-right-value
- full-width-rows
- subtle-separators
- grouped-sections
- centered-content
- generous-whitespace
- tappable-row-structure
content.functions:
Low-level actions (per-row)
- Tap Name: open text input/keyboard, edit the name string (e.g., change "Pumpkin Latte"). Input shows caret, validation on Save.
- Tap Size: open a size selector or wheel; choose from preset sizes (e.g., 12oz, 15oz). The right-side value updates to show the selection.
- Tap Icon: open an icon picker grid or modal to choose a small illustration; the right-side preview replaces the thumbnail.
- Tap Color: open color palette or color picker; selecting a color updates the circular swatch on the right.
- Tap Animation: open a modal list of animation presets (e.g., "Micro Bubbles"), selecting one updates the right-side label.
- Tap Hydration: open numeric input/slider to set percent; the value (e.g., 70%) updates live; potential validation for range 0–100%.
- Tap Caffeine: open numeric input to enter mg; the right-side value updates and may show units (mg).
- Tap Alcohol: toggle or open a selection (Yes/No) for alcoholic content.
Medium-level workflows
- Edit an existing drink: combine editing fields above to change a drink definition quickly. The interface supports quick changes to visual/metadata attributes that affect how the item appears elsewhere (icon, color, animation).
- Create a new drink: use fields sequentially to define all required properties, then tap Save to persist the new profile.
- Preview & test: after selecting icon, color, and animation, user can Save and preview the resulting item in lists or previews elsewhere in the product.
High-level goals
- Primary purpose: configure or edit an item (a beverage/product) with descriptive metadata and visual settings. The screen enables a user to fully define the product’s display attributes (name, size, icon, color, animation) and functional attributes (hydration %, caffeine mg, alcohol flag).
- How UI supports goals: the single-column card list provides a predictable, scannable layout where each editable attribute is clearly labeled and affordances (right-side values, swatches, thumbnails) communicate current state. Primary action (SAVE) is visually prominent to finalize changes; Cancel is present but de-emphasized to avoid accidental loss. Grouping and separators help break fields into logical sections (visual attributes vs. nutritional/functional attributes).

content.description:
High-level summary: A minimal, centered selection screen for choosing an "Animation" style. The layout is vertically stacked with a large decorative illustration at the top, a prominent title, three vertically arranged option rows (one visually selected), and two large pill-shaped action buttons anchored near the bottom. The design uses generous white space, rounded shapes, soft shadows and muted, natural colors to achieve a calm, friendly settings UI.

Canvas & background
- Background: solid off-white (#FBFBFB) filling the full screen.
- Status bar visible at the top (time/status icons), so screen appears like a native mobile full-screen view.

Top illustration
- Large single illustration centered horizontally under the status bar. Illustration color uses the primary teal/blue-green (#45838B). Accent highlights on the illustration are lighter (very pale teal/near-white). Illustration occupies about 30–38% of the screen width and approximately 18–22% of vertical space. It is a flat vector/illustration (no heavy gradients).

Title
- Text: "Animation" centered below the illustration.
- Typography: Friendly rounded geometric sans (similar to SF Rounded or Nunito). Approximate size: 28–34pt, weight: semibold/700. Color: dark desaturated (use primary dark #3E342A for headings). Line-height ~120%.

Options list (single-select)
- Vertical stack of three option items, centered horizontally with large vertical spacing between them.
- Items (top to bottom): "None" (disabled/secondary state), "Micro Bubbles" (selected), "Bubbles" (disabled/secondary state).
- Each option is text-centered. Disabled items use a light gray color (#A9A9A8) and regular weight (~400).
