content.description:
This is a single-column, scrollable informational modal (bottom sheet / dialog) that explains alcohol strength categories (ABV) and what constitutes a standard drink. The screen fills a narrow mobile viewport (iPhone-like, 375pt width) with a white/very light background (main BG: #FBFBFB). At the very top is the iOS status bar (time on the left, signal/wifi/battery on the right) overlaid on the content. Below the status bar the content begins with a left-aligned block of multi-paragraph body text consisting of an explanatory paragraph followed by repeated category blocks. Each category block includes: a bold/semibold short title line (e.g., "Light 1-4% ABV"), then an example line in regular weight (e.g., "example: Light Beer"), then a measurement line in regular weight (e.g., "1 standard drink = 12oz (355ml)"). Text is left-aligned and uses ample vertical spacing between lines and between blocks.

Visual style and color palette (from the screenshot):
- Background: #FBFBFB (very light / off-white)
- Primary text (body & headings): muted charcoal/gray — use #3C3127 as primary dark color for strong text or headings (as provided), or for slightly lighter body copy use #7C6C63 / #7D746C for less-highlighed copy. The design uses multiple warm gray/brown grays: #3C3127, #7C6C63, #9B9A99, #7D746C, plus #FBFBFB for background.
- Button (primary) background: dark charcoal / deep tone consistent with #3C3127 (use as primary button fill). Primary button text is white (#FBFBFB).
- Button (secondary) background: white (#FBFBFB) with subtle shadow and the label in dark charcoal (#3C3127 or #7C6C63).

Typography (recommended to match appearance):
- Font family: San Francisco / SF Pro Text (iOS system) or Roboto for Android if needed.
- Body copy: 17–18 pt (approx. 16–18 px depending on density), weight: Regular (400). Line-height: 1.5 (approx 26–28 px). Color: #7D746C / #9B9A99 for a muted look.
- Section title (category line): 18–20 pt, weight: Semibold (600). Color: #3C3127.
- Example & measurement lines: 16–17 pt, Regular (400), color: #7C6C63 or #9B9A99.
- Buttons label: 17–20 pt, Semibold (600) for strong call-to-action; primary button label white, secondary label dark.

Layout & spacing details:
- Safe area: keep 16–20 pt side padding on left and right for content; the screenshot shows more left padding (approx 24–28 pt) giving a centered column with generous left whitespace.
- Content column: single column, left-aligned text block occupying ~75% of screen width with consistent left margin ~24 px and right margin ~24 px.
- Vertical spacing: paragraph top margin ~20–28 px; between category title and example line ~6–8 px; between example and measurement line ~6–8 px; between separate category blocks ~20–28 px.
- The content area is scrollable vertically. The lower part of the content scrolls under a floating action area composed of two pill-shaped buttons.

Buttons / actions (bottom floating action bar):
- Two pill buttons sit side-by-side, centered horizontally near the bottom of the viewport, overlapping the content area as part of a bottom sheet / floating footer effect. They appear as large rounded rectangles (height ~64 px, width each ~150–170 px) with a large corner radius ~32 px (fully pill-shaped). Space between them ~16–20 px.
- Left button: "Cancel" — white fill (#FBFBFB), label color dark (#3C3127 or #7C6C63), subtle inner shadow or thin border to separate from background. It has a large soft drop shadow under it (diffuse, low-opacity) to create the floating effect.
- Right button: "Apply" — dark fill (use #3C3127), label white (#FBFBFB). It also has a large soft drop shadow and slightly higher visual weight.
- Both buttons have tactile sizing — large touch targets (~64 px height) and centered text, semibold weight.
- Shadows: soft, blur heavy, offset small (suggestion: rgba(60,49,39,0.08) with blur 30–40 px and y-offset 8–10 px) producing the soft floating look.

Borders & dividers: there are no harsh separators between category blocks — the design uses whitespace as the separator. No visible lines or cards.

Iconography: minimal — no visible icons in content area other than standard status bar icons.

Interaction / states: Buttons have pressed states (slightly darker for primary, slight inset for secondary). Scrolling should push content under the floating action area or the bottom sheet may be dismissible with swipe down. Text blocks are selectable if desired.

Animation (optional suggestions to replicate feel):
- Bottom buttons appear with a subtle move-up + fade-in when the sheet opens (duration 260–320ms, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for a smooth, medium-bouncy feel).
- Button press gives a short-scale or opacity change (50–120ms) easing ease-in-out.

Accessibility: provide larger text support, ensure contrast of primary button text over the dark button is >= AA, and ensure large touch targets for the pill buttons.

Overall visual style: Minimal, iOS native look: generous whitespace, soft warm gray palette, clear readable type, pill-shaped floating action buttons with large soft shadows, single-column text-first information presentation. The screen reads like an informational help/clarification modal used as part of a filtering or settings flow.
content.layout:
Overall the screen is a single-column vertical layout designed for a narrow mobile viewport (iPhone-like). Detailed layout breakdown:
- Columns: 1 main column (left-aligned content column). The column occupies roughly 70–80% of the horizontal space from a left margin ~24 px and right margin ~24 px.
- Header: no persistent app header shown; top area contains only the iOS status bar (not a full navigation bar). The content begins under the status bar with a small top padding ~32–40 px.
- Content block: stacked vertical groups (one paragraph introduction, then multiple repeated category groups). Each category group contains 3 rows: title (semibold), example (regular), measurement (regular). The groups are stacked with consistent vertical rhythm: 20–28 px between groups.
- Bottom action area: a floating two-button group is centered horizontally and anchored near the bottom safe area. The group horizontally contains 2 pill buttons arranged side-by-side. Each pill is of equal height (~64 px) and roughly equal width (~150–170 px) with a ~16–20 px gap between them.
- Scrolling: content is scrollable vertically; the bottom buttons remain visually floating above content (either fixed or presented as part of a bottom sheet). The content can slide underneath these buttons while scrolling.
- Safe area handling: the bottom action group respects the device safe area (extra bottom padding) and elevates above any system indicators.

Grid / columns: There is no multi-column grid. The layout is effectively a 1-column typographic grid with consistent left alignment. Use a single-column 1/1 grid with baseline rhythm defined by 8 px increments.

Keywords to describe layout: single-column, left-aligned text, scrollable, bottom-floating actions, pill-buttons, generous whitespace, content-first, safe-area aware, stacked blocks, large touch targets.
content.functions:
Specific actions available on this screen:
- Scrolling: the user can vertically scroll the content to read all ABV categories and examples.
- Reading: user inspects explanatory text on alcohol-by-volume categories and what constitutes "1 standard drink" for each category.
- Dismiss/Cancel: tapping the "Cancel" pill button dismisses the modal without applying changes.
- Apply/Confirm: tapping the "Apply" pill button confirms or applies the related filter/setting (inferred) and closes the modal.

How UI elements support these actions:
- Large, readable body text with clear headings and examples lets users quickly scan and understand ABV categories.
- Generous spacing and left alignment make the reading flow straightforward on a narrow mobile viewport.
- Two large, clearly labelled pill buttons provide immediate action affordances (dismiss vs apply). Their contrasting fills (white vs dark) visually indicate primary vs secondary actions.
- Floating placement of actions keeps them easy to reach with the thumb while reading, speeding up decision-making.

Medium-level tasks (workflows):
- Review ABV definitions: a user can scroll through categories to determine which category their drink belongs to based on ABV and typical serving size.
- Make a filter decision: the modal likely supports or supplements a filter selection elsewhere; after reviewing, the user either cancels or taps Apply to use the information in the main flow.
- Confirm understanding: user reads and then confirms (Apply) or dismisses if they only needed to check the information.

Broader purpose achieved by the screen:
- Educate and disambiguate: this screen's primary goal is to educate users about alcohol strength categories and standard drink volumes so they can accurately use consumption tracking, filters, or settings elsewhere in the product.
- Assist in accurate data entry or filtering: by giving clear examples and measurement conversions, it reduces errors and improves user confidence when they select ABV-related options in the parent flow.

Design rationale for achieving goals:
- The text-first layout prioritizes legibility and comprehension; the floating action pills make completing the decision quick and touch-friendly. Using warm muted grays reduces visual noise and focuses attention on the actionable controls.

content.description: Overall style: Clean, modern iOS-style single-column mobile list with heavy use of rounded shapes, pill chips and soft shadows. Use a light neutral background (near-white) with dark charcoal headings and cyan accents for interactive elements. Visual language is friendly and slightly playful via colorful small illustrations for each drink. Use large spacing, generous padding and 12–16px corner radii to create soft, touch-friendly targets. Palette (use these exact hex values): - Background / paper: #FBFBFB - Primary text / headings: #3A3739 - Secondary text / metadata: #ACADA9 - Accent / primary action & toggles: #0ABDD6 - Accent secondary (used for small highlights or notification): #DCBC05 Additional neutral tones used for very light card backgrounds: use #F5F6F7 (approx) for inner card surfaces. Typography: - Font family: SF Pro / Inter / System UI (iOS look) - Heading / item title: 18–20px, 600 (Semibold), line-height 24px, color #3A3739, left-aligned - Small subtitle (metadata like "75mg caffeine"): 12–13px, 400 (Regular), line-height 16px, color #ACADA9 - Category chips text: 14px, 500 (Medium), color #3A3739 (or #FFFFFF when active) - Header title (page title "Beverages"): 20–24px, 700 (Bold) but in the screenshot it’s visually subdued/blurred; center area under status bar - Misc percentage text (e.g., 100%): 16px, 600, color #ACADA9 Layout & structure: - Top status & nav area: top-left back chevron inside a circular white button with subtle shadow (44px diameter). Top-right a rounded pill primary CTA (+Add) 48–52px height, 16–20px horizontal padding, background #0ABDD6, white text and a small drink icon. Centered page title sits between them. - Category filters: directly under nav is a flow / wrap of pill-shaped filter chips. Chips are 36–44px height, horizontal padding 16px, border-radius 20–24px. Spacing between chips: 10–12px horizontally and 10–12px vertically; chips wrap to multiple rows. Active chip style: dark charcoal filled pill (#3A3739) with white text. Inactive chip style: very light gray filled pill (#F5F6F7) with medium gray text (#ACADA9). One chip ("All 117") displays a small numeric badge inside the chip. - Section label: small uppercase label “HYDRATION” centered or left-aligned in 12px, 600, color #ACADA9, letter-spacing 1px. - List area: single column vertical list. Each row is a rounded rectangular card with full-bleed horizontal padding and subtle elevation shadow (soft drop: rgba(58,55,57,0.06) blur 10px, y-offset 6px). Card corner radius: 14–18px. Card vertical spacing: 10–14px between cards. Card paddings: 16px left/right, 14–18px top/bottom. Row content: left aligned small colorful drink illustration (36x36px) with 8–12px gap to text block. Text block is two lines: title (18–20px semibold) above subtitle (12–13px regular). To the right of the text block, aligned center-right, is a percentage value (16px semibold, #ACADA9). Next to the percentage is a large iOS-style toggle control (width ~54px, height ~32px) colored #0ABDD6 when ON, with a white circular knob and a 200ms slide animation. At extreme right of each row there is a faint drag/reorder handle icon (two vertical chevrons) indicating reorderability. - Item states: toggles ON use #0ABDD6 fill, knob white; toggles OFF use very light gray fill (#E9EAEB) and a gray knob. When a row is tapped it should show a subtle highlight (slightly darker card background) and allow access to a detail overlay. Microcopy & icons: small caffeine metadata under some beverages (e.g., "75mg caffeine") in #ACADA9. Each drink illustration uses bright saturated colors that correspond to the beverage (water: cyan glass, coffee: brown cup, tea: green cup, juice: yellow). Spacing & measurements (approx): - Screen safe area left/right margins ~16px - Chip row left/right margin align to cards - Chip height 40px, radius 20px - Card height variable but typical 72–84px - Left icon 36px square - Toggle control 54x32px - Drag handle width ~16px - Vertical spacing between groups 20–28px Motion & animation: - Toggle slide: 180–220ms ease-out with small scale of knob on press - Bottom shadow and card elevation animate subtly on press (scale 0.995) - Filter chip selection animates background color with 150ms ease - Reorder handle drag reveals subtle lift shadow and slightly reduced opacity of other items Accessibility: - Tap targets 44x44px minimum for chips, buttons and toggles - High-contrast text for headings (#3A3739 on #FBFBFB) - Provide labels for toggles and accessibility hints for "includes this beverage in tracking" Reproduction notes: replicate the pill chips as a wrapping flex row; implement list as a single-column vertical scroll view; each list item is a rounded rectangle card with left icon + text and right percentage + toggle, with a subtle drag handle on the far right.
content.layout: Single-column mobile layout with two stacked vertical groups: 1) Top navigation & filter group (nav row + chips) and 2) Scrollable list group (section label + stacked cards). Columns and groups: - Overall: 1 main column. - Top group: navigation row (back button left, title centered, primary CTA right) followed by a wrapped chip group occupying multiple rows (chips flow across width; effectively 3–5 chips per row depending on device width). Count groups: chips arranged in 3 wrapped rows in the screenshot. - List group: a single vertical list composed of repeating card components (count visible ~8 items but list is scrollable). Grid details: not a grid — the chips are a horizontally-wrapping flow container; the list is a vertical stack with consistent card widths equal to container width minus side margins. Alignment & spacing: - All content aligned to a 16px horizontal margin. - Cards are horizontally full-width inside safe area, with inner padding 16px. - Left column inside each card: icon and name/subtitle stacked. - Right column inside each card: numeric percentage and toggle stacked center-right, with drag handle on far right. Visual hierarchy: chips (filter) above, then section label, then list of cards. There are no additional vertical columns or sidebars.
content.functions: Specific actions on this screen: - Tap the back chevron to navigate back. - Tap the +Add pill CTA to add a new beverage (opens a modal or bottom sheet to enter name, icon, volume, caffeine mg and default percentage). - Tap any category chip to filter the list (chips act as multi/select or single-select; active chip becomes filled, list updates to show only matching drinks). - Tap a list row to open details or edit that beverage. - Toggle the on/off switch at the right of each row to include or exclude that beverage from the user’s active tracking set; toggling updates data and the toggle animates. - Long-press or use the drag handle to reorder items in the list (drag to change priority). - Tap the numeric percentage label (or row) to edit the percentage value for that drink (opens inline editor or modal). - Scroll the single-column list to browse additional beverage items. - Visual feedback: toggles and chips provide immediate color changes and subtle haptics (if supported) when toggled. Medium-level workflows: - Filter + include workflow: users select one or more category chips to narrow choices, then toggle ON the drinks they frequently consume to add them to their active list. - Add + configure workflow: tap +Add, fill a short form (name, icon, type, caffeine mg, default percent) and press save to add a custom beverage card to the list. - Reorder + prioritize: long press the drag handle to rearrange list order, which persists across sessions. - Quick edit: tap percentage or row to quickly edit portion size or percentage contribution (used to calculate hydration or caffeine intake). Broader purpose: This screen functions as a beverage catalog and quick configuration area inside a hydration/nutrition tracking product. It enables users to browse available drinks, filter by category, add custom drinks, toggle which drinks are actively tracked, and quickly tune each drink’s relative value (percentage) and caffeine metadata. The UI supports fast scanning and quick decision-making with large touch targets and clear visual cues so users can customize what will be included in their daily tracking or calculations.

records.name: Add missed beverage
records.description: Happy path for adding a missed beverage to a specific date's hydration log. Entry point: user is viewing a single-day hydration detail screen (date header, daily total, list of logged drinks). Exit point: new drink is added to the list, daily hydration and caffeine totals update and the add modal is dismissed. Assumes the user is on the chosen date (April 21, 2026) and has permission to edit that day's entries. Interaction runs entirely on a mobile device; editing and adding happen via a modal bottom sheet.
records.problem: User goal: Manually record a beverage they consumed earlier (a "missed" entry) so the daily hydration and caffeine totals reflect that intake. From the user's perspective they expect to select a time, choose the beverage type, set the serving size, and add the entry; they expect the day totals and the list of entries to update immediately. From the interface perspective the UI must: present a clear entry point to add a missed drink, let the user pick a time (time wheel), let the user pick a beverage from a horizontally scrolling set of icons, allow adjusting the serving size for the selected beverage, provide a prominent Add/confirm control, and then update the day view (list and totals) and dismiss the modal. Result: User-perceived outcome — the new beverage appears in the day's list with the chosen time and size, daily hydration and caffeine badges increase. System-level outcome — a new beverage record is created for the selected date/time with its volume and caffeine value; totals are recalculated.

content.description:
High-level: A clean, airy single-column mobile modal that shows a hydration summary with a large decorative illustration at the top, a prominent numeric summary (oz), small progress copy, a caffeine pill, a chronological list of drink entries (each with an icon, title, volume, optional caffeine chip, and right-aligned timestamp), and two stacked pill CTAs at the bottom.

Canvas & structure
- Screen orientation: portrait, iPhone-like safe area with status indicators visible at top-left and top-right. The content sits inside large vertical white safe-area with generous whitespace.
- Grid / columns: The main content uses a single centered column for the hero / metric area. The drink list below uses an implicit 2-column row per item: a left group (icon + text stack) and a right-aligned timestamp column. Buttons are center-aligned and stacked vertically at the bottom of the content.

Background
- Background: solid off-white/very light gray (#FBFBFA). There is no busy texture — the background is clean to maximize contrast with colorful icons and the illustration.

Illustration / hero
- Large decorative illustration sits at the top half of the screen. It appears as a faint, desaturated silhouette (very light gray overlay) of a llama or mascot in the top-center, with two layered surfboard-like shapes overlapping horizontally near the lower part of the illustration: a green top shape and a blue underside shape. The silhouette is semi-transparent and extremely light to feel decorative rather than focal.
- Illustration colors (mapped to provided palette): silhouette: #FBFBFA blended with #A6ACA7 at ~10% opacity; surfboard top: #05C47C (green); surfboard bottom accent: slightly brighter aqua (use #05C47C as the main green accent from palette; a cyan accent visually appears in the screenshot but keep primary brand accent as #05C47C).

Primary metric block
- Main numeric: large centered number “15.5oz”. Uses a friendly rounded display font (similar to SF Pro Rounded or Avenir Next Rounded) with a heavy weight. Approx sizes: 36–48pt on a 375pt width layout. Color: bright cyan/teal (use #05C47C as primary accent, or for closer visual parity use a slightly more cyan shade derived from accent but keep it high-contrast). Line-height: 1.05. Text alignment: centered.
- Secondary copy below the number: small muted sentence “Hydration • 17% of your goal” — medium weight (500) in grey #A6ACA7, size approx 14–16pt, centered, letter-spacing 0.2pt.
- Tertiary link-style line: “16.5oz consumed in total” in accent color (same as the main numeric but lighter — aqua/teal), size ~15pt, centered. A small droplet icon appears to the right of the text as a discrete inline icon colored in the same accent.
- Caffeine pill: a rounded pill chip directly beneath the tertiary line. Pill background: very soft warm beige/pearl (#FBFBFA with subtle inner shadow) with a thin soft border; pill text: brown/dark coffee color approximating #2D2E39 but warmer. Text reads “31mg caffeine” preceded by a small coffee bean icon. Pill size: about 44–56px height, width auto, horizontal padding 18–20px, border-radius ~28px. Chip has subtle drop shadow and inner light highlight.

Drink list (content area)
- Spacing: large vertical gap between the hero metric block and the first list item (approx 28–36px). Each list row has vertical spacing of ~18–22px between rows.
- Row layout: left column contains a colorful icon (cup / glass) and to the right of the icon a two-line text stack. Right column contains the timestamp aligned to the right.
  - Left icon: flat, simple illustrated glyphs. Example: green teacup for “Green Tea” (color #05C47C mapped to the cup graphic) and a blue water glass for “Water” (use a blue accent derived from the same branding palette). Icon size approx 36–44px square, margin-right ~12–14px.
  - Title: first line is the drink name (e.g., “Green Tea”, “Water”) — weight semi-bold (600), size ~18–20pt. Color: for caffeinated drink title uses brand green #05C47C; for water title uses vivid cyan/blue (mapped to palette accent). Text left-aligned within the left column.
  - Subtitle line(s): immediately below title is a smaller data line showing volume (e.g., “10oz”, “6.5oz”) in dark slate color (#2D2E39) or near-black weight 600, size ~15–16pt. Beside the volume a small caffeine chip appears when relevant (rounded tiny chip with a coffee-bean icon and small numeral ‘31’), chip background pale beige (#FBFBFA) with tiny border, inner text brown (#2D2E39). Spacing: small horizontal gap between volume text and chip ~8px.
  - Timestamp: right column shows the time (e.g., “1:23 PM”) in muted gray #A6ACA7, size ~15–16pt, right-aligned vertically centered with the row. Rows are not separated with harsh borders; separation is achieved through whitespace and subtle shadows.

Buttons / Calls to action
- Two stacked pill buttons near the bottom center: first button “Delete / Edit”, second button “Add a missed entry”. Buttons are wide, centered, with large border-radius (~28–32px) and light cyan background (a pale teal / sky tint derived from the brand accent). Text inside the buttons is teal/blue (accent), semi-bold, size ~16–18pt. Buttons include a soft outer glow shadow (very subtle, spread ~30px, low opacity) that gives them a floating, tactile feel. Horizontal padding ~28–36px, vertical padding ~14–18px. Buttons have distinct separation — the top button sits ~12–16px above the bottom button.
- Top-right dismiss control: circular close button (white circle, subtle drop shadow) with an “X” icon in dark slate (#2D2E39). Size about 44–48px diameter. Positioned inside safe area top-right with ~16–18px margin.

Typography
- Primary display numerals: large rounded display font (SF Pro Rounded / Avenir Next Rounded) weight heavy; size 36–48pt, color accent (#05C47C used as core brand accent).
- Titles: semi-bold (600), ~18–20pt.
- Body / metadata: medium (500), ~14–16pt, color #2D2E39 or muted #A6ACA7 depending on emphasis.
- Chips / tiny labels: small 12–13pt, semi-bold, chip background very light (#FBFBFA) with thin border (very low-contrast grey).

Shadows & effects
- Soft drop shadows: used under the bottom CTAs and under the top-right close circle to create depth. Shadows are low-opacity dark grey (#2D2E3980 at 6–10% opacity) with a spread of ~18–30px and blur radius ~20–40px.
- Chips use inner/outer subtle shadows to feel tactile. List items have no heavy dividers; separation relies on whitespace.

Spacing & measurements (approx, for repro)
- Side padding: 20–24px.
- Top safe area padding: ~18–22px (status bar + top margin). Illustration top margin commencing just below status bar.
- Hero illustration vertical height ~220–260px (bleeds toward top center), metric block sits just below it with ~8–12px spacing.
- List start: ~280–340px from top depending on device height.

Interaction states & hints
- Buttons: default pale teal background; on press state should slightly darken, with reduced shadow. Disabled state: reduce opacity and remove shadow.
- Chips/pills: tappable to reveal nutrition details; on tap they should show an inset press state (slightly darker background).
- Rows: tapping a list row navigates to a detail/edit modal for that drink entry. Long press could open context menu (Delete/Edit). Right-side timestamps are not interactive but support accessibility label announcing time.

Accessibility
- Ensure color contrast: primary numeric and CTA labels must pass contrast with background; if using #05C47C for text on white, verify ratio and consider using darker #2D2E39 for small metadata.
- Touch targets: icons and chips at least 44x44px.

Overall style summary
- Friendly, playful wellness aesthetic with a lot of whitespace, modern rounded typography, soft colorful illustrative icons, pill-shaped controls, and tactile shadows. Color accents are energetic greens/teals with neutral slate greys for text and muted warm beige for info chips.
content.layout:
Overall layout: single-column centered modal with a visual hero at the top, a numeric summary block beneath it, a chronological two-column list for drinks, and two centered pill CTAs near the bottom.

Sections (top-to-bottom):
1) System status / safe area (status bar area with time and indicators).  
2) Top-right dismiss control: circular close button (one small floating element inside top-right safe area).  
3) Hero illustration block: large decorative silhouette + layered surfboard shapes, occupying approx top 30–40% of viewport.  
4) Metric block: large numeric (15.5oz), secondary text lines (hydration percent, total consumed), and informational caffeine pill stacked vertically and centered.  
5) Drink list: a vertical list of rows. Each row is effectively a 2-column layout: left group (icon + a vertical text stack: title above subtitle/chips) and right group (timestamp, right aligned). Count of columns: 2 logical columns per row. The list uses 1 group of rows (single list), not multi-column grid.  
6) Action area: two vertical pill CTAs centered; they sit above the bottom safe area with a lot of whitespace below.

Detailed row structure (grid-like description):
- Row height: ~56–72px depending on content.  
- Left column width: ~65–80px reserved for icons and left padding.  
- Middle text column: occupies the remainder of left area after icon (flex column). Title top, subtitle and small chip inline below.

content.description:
Overview
- Portrait mobile screen showing a daily hydration summary with a half-height modal/bottom sheet slid up from the bottom to add a missed entry. The top half of the screen is the main daily summary (dimmed by an overlay), the bottom half is a white rounded sheet containing the "Add a missed entry" form.
Overall style
- Clean, modern, friendly iOS-like aesthetic with generous white space, rounded corners, soft shadows and playful flat illustrations for drinks. Visual hierarchy uses a large centered date, a prominent numeric amount, muted secondary text and colorful accent icons.
Color palette
- Primary dark heading / body: #3F4749 (rgb(63,71,73)) used for main headings and text.
- Muted gray: #9B9B9B (rgb(155,155,155)) used for secondary/subhead text and disabled states.
- Mustard / accent (used for small highlights / coffee/caffeine): #BDAD20 (rgb(189,173,32)).
- Brown / caffeine label text: #8B730B (rgb(139,115,11)) used in the caffeine pill label.
- Teal / main accent: #13C897 (rgb(19,200,151)) used for numeric amounts and important links.
- Background overlay: very light desaturated gray (approx #F1F2F4) used to dim the content behind the bottom sheet.
Screen structure and layout
- Status bar area at top (safe area) followed by a centered main header with the date text "April 21, 2026".
- Below the date: a large numeric summary value (e.g., "15.5oz") centered and colored in the teal accent. Under that a subdued subhead line "Hydration • 17% of your goal" in muted gray and a teal link-like line "16.5oz consumed in total" with a small droplet icon to the right.
- A rounded pill badge centered beneath the totals showing "31mg caffeine". The pill has a soft shadow and a light background (off-white or very light gray) and small coffee-bean icon on the left.
- A vertical list of consumed items (partially visible behind the sheet): each row has a left aligned illustrated drink icon (colorful flat illustration), then the drink name (e.g., "Green Tea") using a bright green color, under that a small bold qty text (e.g., "10oz") and a small caffeine badge inline. On the right side of each row is a timestamp (e.g., "1:23 PM") in muted gray and a circular pink-ish delete button with a minus sign.
Bottom sheet (Add a missed entry)
- The bottom sheet occupies roughly the lower 45-55% of the screen. It has a white background, large top-left/top-right corner radii (approx 20–28px), a subtle top shadow and a faint drag handle (optional) above the title.
- Title text centered near the top of the sheet: "Add a missed entry" in the same dark heading color (#3F4749), large and bold (approx 28–36pt depending on device scale) with comfortable vertical padding.
- A round translucent close button with an 'X' icon sits near the top-right of the sheet, overlapping slightly into the sheet's header area.
- Time picker: A 3-column wheel picker (hour | minute | AM/PM) centered horizontally below the title. The selected row is highlighted by a rounded horizontal selection band (a very light gray pill) with the selected values shown in dark text; the non-selected values above/below are faded (low opacity). The wheel items use numeric large typography for readability (approx 28–40pt). The highlighted selection band height is ~60px.
- Under the picker: a horizontal row / carousel of beverage illustrations (large, colorful icons) with labels underneath. Each beverage card is minimal: an illustrated container (e.g., blue glass for water, green cup for green tea, brown cup for coffee etc.) approximately 48–64px tall, with a small circular plus button (accent teal or light aqua background with a white plus icon) partially overlapping the lower portion of the illustration indicating an add action.
- Labels under icons are uppercase small text in muted gray; the drink name text under the icon includes a very light label color for inactive state and teal/green for active state. There are 5–6 items visible in the row across the sheet width. The icons are evenly spaced with equal horizontal padding (~18–24px between icons).
Typography
- Suggested system fonts: SF Pro Display / SF Pro Rounded or Inter / Poppins as alternatives. Use a rounded humanist sans for the friendly feel.
- Title: 28–34pt, weight 700 (bold), center aligned.
- Large amount on main screen: 36–44pt, weight 600–700, teal (#13C897).
- Subhead lines: 14–16pt, weight 400–500, color #9B9B9B.
- Time picker digits: 30–42pt, weight 500–600, highlighted value ~#3F4749.
- Row item titles: 16–18pt, weight 600, colored (e.g., green for Green Tea). Quantity badges: 14pt, semibold.
UI elements details
- Pills / badges: capsules with very light background (#F6F6F7), inner text color brown for caffeine pill (#8B730B), small icon on left (~14–16px).
- Close / delete buttons: circular buttons with subtle drop shadow and faint border; delete uses pale pink background and a minus icon.
- Drink icons: flat, playful vector illustrations with consistent stroke/shape language; each has a small circular add button anchored near lower center of the icon (circle ~26px with shadow).
- Spacing & padding: main container horizontal padding ~24px; vertical spacing between main date and amount ~12–18px; between amount and pill ~16px. Bottom sheet internal horizontal padding ~20–24px and top padding ~18–20px.
Shadows & elevation
- Bottom sheet has a soft upward drop shadow (y-offset ~-6px, blur ~18px, rgba(63,71,73,0.08)). The pill badges have small inner shadows for subtle depth.
Animations (recommended)
- Bottom sheet: slide-up with easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) over 320ms when opened; slide-down when closed with matching easing.
- Wheel picker: momentum scroll with deceleration and snapping to center value; selected value fades in to full opacity and scale, surrounding values fade to ~40% opacity.
- Icon tap microinteraction: 1) quick scale up to 1.07x then back to 1.0 over 180ms, 2) plus button ripple/pulse and a short check animation when added.
Accessibility
- Ensure high-contrast text alternatives, large touch targets for plus/minus (44px minimum), and VoiceOver labels for each drink icon and buttons.
Assets to provide
- SVG vector illustrations for each beverage (consistent stroke, same baseline), X icon and circular plus/minus controls, droplet icon, caffeine bean icon, pill background shapes, and time picker style.
Notes for recreation
- Recreate the dim overlay above the main screen when the sheet is open to suggest modal focus. Keep type scale consistent with iOS typographic rhythm. Use generous corner radii and soft shadows to achieve the friendly, tactile feel.

content.description:
Overview
- Full-screen iOS-style screen with a large, rounded white bottom sheet overlay anchored to the bottom and covering most of the viewport. The underlying app chrome (status bar and a blurred date header) is visible above the sheet.

Background and sheet
- Background behind the sheet: very light gray overlay (#FBFBFB used as a desaturated dim layer); the top area shows blurred/dimmed app content (partial date text). The overlay softens the background with ~30-40% opacity.
- Bottom sheet: pure white (#FFFFFF) card with large top corners (rounded radius ~28–36 px). The sheet has a faint inner top shadow / soft vignette to separate it from the dimmed background. The sheet sits with ~24 px horizontal margin from device edges on wide phones.

Top controls
- Left: a small rounded pill tag showing time ("9:15 AM"). Tag background is pale pink-beige (approx #FBF0EE or a very light tint); text color is warm coffee brown (#7D4E3F). Pill shape has radius ~18 px, padding L/R ~12 px, height ~36 px. Text style: medium weight, ~13–14 pt, letter spacing normal, centered vertically.
- Right: circular close button (white circle with subtle shadow) containing an X icon in dark gray/blue (#444C6C). Button diameter ~44 px, positioned flush with the sheet top-right with ~12–16 px margin. X icon ~16–18 px stroke weight medium.

Main illustration
- Dominant central vector illustration of a coffee cup in a flat, minimal style. Cup color is rich brown (~#7D4E3F or close) matching the palette. Cup is centered horizontally, taking roughly 56–64% of sheet width and about 50–55% of sheet height.
- Inside the cup a circular translucent control (radial gradient from pale pink-beige to slightly darker brown) overlays the cup center; it contains two small chevron icons (up and down) stacked vertically in dark navy (#33271E or #444C6C). This control is roughly 56–72 px diameter, hinting at an interactive volume increment/decrement.
- Small white bean-shaped highlights/illustrative shapes placed on the cup surface (soft white #FBFBFB or very pale gray) and tiny decorative dots scatter across the cup for texture.

Measurement text
- Below the cup: large numeric measurement text reading "8.0oz". Typeface is a neutral geometric sans (iOS San Francisco / SF Pro / system font). Style: bold/semibold, large size ~36–48 pt, color dark navy (#444C6C). Center aligned.
- To the right of the measurement, a secondary faint label shows another measurement option (e.g., "12.0oz") in light gray (#9B9CA0) at lower opacity (~40–50%), suggesting a horizontal paging of size options.

Primary action
- Below the measurement: a prominent rounded pill CTA button "+ COFFEE" in the same coffee brown (#7D4E3F). Button height ~56 px, horizontal padding ~32 px, corner radius ~28 px. Label is uppercase, white (#FFFFFF), bold (~16–18 pt). Button casts a subtle soft shadow and has a pressed state that slightly darkens the brown and reduces elevation.
- To the right of the CTA is a small circular secondary control (pale pink/beige background like the time pill) containing a dotted-grid icon (three-by-three small dots) in muted brown/gray (#33271E or #444C6C). Diameter ~44 px; it likely opens additional options or a context menu.

Spacing and alignment
- Layout is a single centered column: top tag and close at sheet header, large centered hero illustration, numeric measurement below, then CTA and small secondary control near the bottom. Horizontal alignment centered for primary elements.
- Vertical spacing: sheet top padding ~20–28 px, gap between illustration and measurement ~24–36 px, gap between measurement and CTA ~18–28 px, bottom safe area padding to device edge ~20–28 px.

Typography
- System font (SF Pro / iOS system) used throughout. Weights vary: medium/semibold for small labels and pill, bold/semibold for the measurement and CTA label.
- Sizes estimated: time pill 13–14 pt medium; measurement 36–48 pt bold; CTA label 16–18 pt bold; small faint measurement 14–16 pt regular.

Color palette (extracted and extended)
- Dark navy / primary text: #444C6C (used for main numeric label, icons, status text)
- Secondary gray: #9B9CA0 (used for faint measurement and muted UI)
- Coffee brown (illustration, CTA): #7D4E3F (primary brand/CTA color)

- Off-white / sheet background: #FBFBFB / #FFFFFF (sheet and page background)
- Pill backgrounds: pale pink-beige (approx #FBF0EE or #F6EDEB) — use for time pill and secondary circular control
- CTA text: #FFFFFF

Iconography & shapes
- Icons are simple, minimal, single-color (flat) glyphs — X, chevrons. Use 2–3 px stroke weights scaled proportionally.
- All interactive controls use rounded geometry (pills, circles, rounded rectangle CTA).

Interaction & states
- Sheet opens with a smooth upward motion (spring easing) from the bottom; dismiss via tapping X, tapping outside area, or swiping down.
- CTA press: quick scale down (0.96) and darker brown overlay for 120–160 ms, then success toast.
- Volume control (chevrons): tapping up/down animates a small filled ring pulse and animates the numeric value change with a short scale + fade micro-animation (ease-out 160–200 ms).
- Horizontal paging of measurements: small parallax effect between the main measurement and the faint adjacent measurement as the user swipes left/right.

Accessibility
- Buttons use sufficient contrast: CTA brown vs white text meets AA for large text; ensure icons have accessible labels.
- Large touch targets: all circular buttons >= 44x44 px.

Re-creation notes
- Use SF Pro or a similar neutral sans; keep the coffee brown and dark navy as primary brand colors. Recreate the cup illustration using simple vector shapes with flat fills and a couple of subtle highlights. Maintain large negative space around the hero to emphasize the CTA and measurement.

Keywords to describe layout

content.functions:
Specific actions (micro-interactions)
- Tap the circular close (X) in the top-right to dismiss the sheet immediately. The X has a touch target ~44 px.
- Tap the time pill in the top-left to open a time picker modal (or edit the timestamp). The pill is a tappable tag with a highlighted active state (slightly darker background and border).
- Tap the chevrons inside the circular overlay on the cup to increment or decrement the current serving volume by pre-set steps (e.g., 0.5 oz or 1.0 oz). Each tap triggers a small value-change animation on the measurement text.
- Swipe horizontally on the cup or the measurement area to switch between preset serving sizes (e.g., 8.0 oz, 12.0 oz). The adjacent faint measurement indicates the next/previous option.
- Tap the main CTA "+ COFFEE" to add the currently selected serving to the log. After pressing, the app provides feedback (success toast or a confirmation animation) and then dismisses or remains open for additional entries.
- Tap the small circular dotted menu to open more options (e.g., select coffee type, add notes, or open quantity presets). This opens a small popover or side sheet.
- Swipe down on the sheet to dismiss it (gesture-based dismiss). A drag handle or subtle affordance is implied by the sheet geometry.

Medium-level workflows
- Quick add flow: User opens the sheet, adjusts serving size with the chevrons or swipes to a preset, confirms time if needed by tapping the time pill, then taps "+ COFFEE" to create an entry. The UI provides immediate feedback and optionally returns to the previous screen with updated totals.
- Multi-entry flow: After adding one coffee, the sheet remains open so the user can quickly add additional servings by repeating the selection.
- Advanced options: Tapping the dotted menu reveals coffee type, notes, or frequency choices; selecting any of those updates the illustration or metadata before confirming.

Broader goal accomplished
- The screen’s overall purpose is to let users quickly log a cup of coffee (a consumption event) with a chosen volume and timestamp. The UI emphasizes speed and clarity — a large hero illustration anchors the task, a large numeric measurement communicates the current selection, and a single prominent CTA makes the primary action (adding coffee) obvious. Secondary controls let the user fine-tune the entry (time, size presets, additional options) without overwhelming the main flow.

content.description:
Overview
- Single-screen mobile detail view for a daily hydration / beverage log. Clean, airy layout with a lot of white space and soft shadows. The visual hierarchy centers on a large, bold date at the top, a prominent numeric hydration metric below it, and contextual status text and badges underneath. Below the summary is a vertically stacked list of drink entries (illustrated icon, drink name, volume, caffeine badge, timestamp, and a round minus/delete control). A large rounded CTA sits near the lower-middle area to add a missed entry.
Color palette (observed + inferred)
- Background: very light off-white: #FBFBFB (given)
- Primary accent / positive teal: #10C3B4 (given) used for the main metric, links and the CTA text
- Highlight / accent yellow: #D7BE0A (given) — used sparingly (brand tone provided)
- Dark text / headings: #392F26 (given) used for date and some headings
- Muted gray for secondary text: #A6A7A5 (given) used for descriptors and timestamps
- Light neutral chip background: #F3EDEE (approx) used for caffeine chips and badges
- Pink delete control background: #FFDCE1 (approx) circular minus buttons on the right
- Teal water droplet icon inside the “24.5oz consumed” link: #BDEFF3 (lighter teal)
- Shadows: soft, warm drop shadows with low opacity (RGBA approx: rgba(16,195,180,0.08) for CTA and rgba(0,0,0,0.06) for list items)
Typography
- Headline date: large rounded humanist sans (similar to Inter / Nunito Sans / Avenir Next Rounded). Weight ~700; size ~28–34px; center-aligned; color #392F26
- Main metric: bold display number in bright teal #10C3B4; weight 700; size ~36–44px; center-aligned; tight leading
- Subheader hydration stat: medium weight (500–600); size ~14–16px; color #A6A7A5; center-aligned
- Secondary link (24.5oz consumed): medium weight; teal color #10C3B4; size ~14px; center-aligned
- Section labels (drink names): weight 700; size ~18–20px; left-aligned; color varies per drink (green for Green Tea #6FB61A, blue for Water #10C3B4, brown for Coffee #6A3F32) — these appear to use brand color accents per drink type
- Body / metadata (volume text like “10oz”): weight 600; size ~14px; color #392F26 or near-black
- Timestamp: regular weight; size ~14px; color #A6A7A5; right aligned
- Small chip text (caffeine mg): size ~12px; weight 600; color #6A3F32 for coffee chip icon + dark text
Layout and spacing
- Safe area top margin ~28–36 px; the date sits near the top center
- Vertical spacing: ~12–18 px between date, metric, and subtext lines; ~24–32 px between the summary block and the first list item
- Page uses a single column center-aligned layout for the header/summary. Below the summary the content switches to a left-aligned list with three visual columns inside each row:
  1) Left icon column: fixed width ~48–56px containing a colorful illustrated icon (cup, glass, to-go cup), vertically centered in the row.
  2) Main content column: flexible width; includes drink name (top, bold) and volume + small caffeine chip (below or inline) — vertical stack with ~6–8px spacing.
  3) Right action column: narrow column aligned to the right with timestamp above and a circular pink delete button (minus) to the far right. Timestamp is horizontally aligned with drink name for visual balance.
- Row height: ~72–84 px per entry; left and right padding ~20–24 px; intra-row spacing ~12–16 px
- Caffeine chip: pill-shaped, rounded corners ~20–26 px height, subtle inner shadow and a small coffee-bean icon on the left; background ~#F3EDEE and text color ~#6A3F32; small badge margin-left from amount
Controls and UI elements (visual details)
- Close action top-right: circular white button with subtle drop shadow and an X icon; diameter ~44px; float over content with soft shadow.
- Delete action: circular pink control with a small minus icon centered; size ~36px; background ~#FFDCE1; soft shadow; positioned on the right edge of each row.
- Caffeine & water badges: small rounded chips with an icon on the left and numeric text (e.g., “131mg caffeine” or coffee-bean + “100”) — background is very light neutral (#F3EDEE), text uses brown accent for readability.
- CTA (“Add a missed entry”): large rounded pill (full width approx 70% of content width / centered), soft teal gradient background (left #DFF8F6 -> right #BEEFF1) or subtle flat teal fill, text in #10C3B4, inner drop shadow and outer soft shadow for elevation. Height ~52–60px; corner radius ~28–30px.
- Use of illustrations: flat, solid-color, friendly icons with subtle shadow and slightly rounded shapes
States & animation (inferred)
- Micro-interactions: subtle elevation on CTA press (scale 0.98), ripple or color change on row press, reveal of delete action (or tap to show confirmation). Soft fade-and-slide for list item removal. Opening/closing the screen likely uses a short easing (cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)) and 180–260ms duration.
Accessibility notes
- High-contrast primary metric (teal) against white background; secondary text uses medium gray—ensure minimum contrast compliance for body text.
- Tap targets are large (>=44px) for delete and close actions.
Assets / icons
- Cup / glass / to-go cup illustrations are custom vector icons with 3–4 distinct fill colors per icon (cup body, liquid, highlight, outline).
- Coffee-bean icon used inside caffeine chips.

Recreation summary
- Use a vertical single-column layout with center-aligned header/summary and a left-aligned list below. Recreate pill badges and rounded CTA with soft shadows. Keep large whitespace and friendly rounded typography. Maintain the color palette and per-row three-column arrangement for icon / content / actions.

Keywords to describe layout

content.functions:

records.name: Supporter donation & unlock
records.description: Happy-path: A user discovers a “Become a Supporter” card inside the main feed, opens it, selects frequency (one-time or monthly), adjusts a donation amount with a horizontal step slider (which updates a price label and the CTA copy), taps the CTA to pay, confirms via Apple Pay, then sees a success confirmation and an unlocked character splash with share options. Entry point: main feed where the supporter card is displayed. Exit points: success modal acknowledgment (OK) and the unlocked character/sharing screen; the user is returned to the feed with the new character added to their collection. Assumptions: user is on iOS with Apple Pay available and already signed into the platform/store; the app has permission to start in-app purchases and the user has stored cards; the user is online.
records.problem: User task (user perspective): The user wants to financially support the app/team, pick how much and whether it’s a one-time or recurring contribution, pay quickly using a native payment method, and receive a visible thank-you (a unique character) they can view/share. They expect an easy, low-friction selection of amount and immediate confirmation with an unlocked reward. Interface task (system perspective): The UI must present support options, let the user toggle frequency, select an amount via a discrete slider with immediate price and CTA feedback, start the platform-native purchase flow (Apple Pay), handle confirmation and errors, show a success state, and add/unlock the reward in the user’s collection. Final result: User-perceived outcome — a successful payment confirmation and an unlocked character splash with sharing choices; System-level outcome — an in-app purchase is initiated and completes, the app receives acknowledgement of the purchase and marks the character as unlocked/available in the user's inventory/collection.

content.description:
Mobile portrait screen (iPhone-style safe area) composed of two stacked rounded cards and a large illustrated character. Overall style: playful, friendly, modern flat-illustration product-card look with generous white space, heavy use of rounded corners, soft shadows, and bright accent colors. Type system: geometric rounded sans (recommend Montserrat, Avenir Next Rounded, or SF Pro Rounded). Use bold weights for headings, medium for subheadings, and regular for body copy.

Top area / Status: visible iOS status indicators (time, signal, wifi, battery) in white. Two small circular controls float over the top card: a progress circle at top-left (brown circle with blue arc and a small white numerals "1"), and a rounded gradient action button at top-right with a three-wave or menu icon.

Upper card (hero challenge): full-width rounded rectangle with a warm mustard-yellow background (use main accent #E3C00B). Corner radius ~28–32 px. On the card top-left small uppercase label "10-DAY CHALLENGE" in muted purple/dark-red (#912E2C) at 12–14 px uppercase medium weight. Main title "Drop Beer Deer" set in large white bold (approx 28–34 px), left aligned with ~24–28 px internal left padding. Right side of the card contains a half-cut flat vector deer illustration (cropped on the right edge) with smooth shadows and slightly desaturated colors; the illustration overlaps the inner padding but remains inside the card edges. Card has subtle inner shadow or soft drop shadow below to lift above the background.

Main support card (lower large card): vertically stacked, large rounded rectangle with light pastel cyan background (#E6F9FB or mix of #06BEEA with white) and thin bright-cyan outline border (~2 px, #06BEEA / #10A9D6). Corner radius ~26–30 px. Card spacing: top margin from hero card ~28–36 px. Card internal padding approx 28–32 px.
- Left column (content): heading "Become a Supporter" in bold teal (#06BEEA) about 26–30 px. Body copy below in muted slate/gray (#6B7C86 or #6E7B83) 14–16 px, line-height ~20–22 px, describing the offer (2–4 lines).
- Subscription options: two vertically stacked radio rows. First row shows a filled circular teal radio with a white check mark and label "ONE-TIME" in teal bold (12–14 px). Second row shows an empty light-gray radio and the label "MONTHLY" in muted gray. Radios are 22–28 px diameter, spacing ~12–16 px between radio and label.
- Price: a pill-shaped white badge centered or left aligned showing "5,99€" in teal (#06BEEA) bold, about 20–22 px, with inner padding 10–14 px and subtle shadow. This pill sits above a horizontal progress/slider control.
- Slider / progress track: light-cyan horizontal line with 5 equally spaced circular step markers. Track thickness ~6–8 px, color very light cyan (#CFF4F9), with filled sections in slightly darker cyan (#AEEFF9). Current knob is a circular white token (~56 px) with an inner thumbnail image (stacked donuts) centered and a soft drop shadow; the knob visually sits slightly above the track. The track has small circular milestones that are 16–20 px.
- Large CTA: centered full-width pill button near bottom of the card in vibrant cyan (#06BEEA / #10A9D6), corner radius 30–40 px, height ~56 px. Button text "Get donuts for creators!" set in white, bold, ~18–20 px. Button has subtle elevation/shadow and a small inward padding.
- Footer/dismiss: below button a subtle secondary text "DISMISS" in very light grey (#DDE6E8) uppercase, small (~12–13 px) and centered.

Right column (illustration): a tall stylized Okapi / deer character occupies the card's right edge, cropped vertically so only half the body shows. The character uses saturated flat colors with small decorative accessories (necklace letters "OKAPI" etc.), matching the brand's playful tone. The illustration partially overlays the card edge but remains inside the card's bounding radius.

Colors (recommended hexs used):
- Mustard yellow (hero card background): #E3C00B
- Bright cyan / primary CTA: #06BEEA
- Deep indigo / accent (maybe headings or dark text): #29318E
- Accent red / decorative (small label): #912E2C
- Secondary cyan / alt CTA: #10A9D6
- Light card background: #E9FBFD or #F5FEFF (pale cyan)
- Body text: #6E7B83 (muted gray)
- White: #FFFFFF

Typography sizes (approx, for 375 pt wide mobile):
- Large hero heading: 28–34 px, bold
- Card heading: 26–30 px, bold
- Body text: 14–16 px, regular
- Labels (radio): 12–14 px, medium
- CTA text: 18–20 px, bold

Shadows & elevation: use soft drop shadows under cards (y-offset 6–12 px, blur 20–28 px, rgba(41,49,142,0.08)) and stronger shadow under CTA (rgba(6,190,234,0.18)).

States & interactions:
- Radios: checked state is filled teal circle with white check icon; unchecked state is light-gray outline.
- Slider: dragging the knob moves a small donut thumbnail and updates price pill; intermediate milestones change color when passed. Provide subtle scale-up animation on knob when pressed (scale 1.06) with 120ms easing.
- CTA button: on press briefly darkens (overlay rgba(0,0,0,0.06)) and slopes elevation.

Spacing & layout metrics (approx):
- Screen safe width: 360–390 pts; main card horizontal margin 16–20 px from edges. Hero card height ~130–150 px. Support card height ~520–580 px.
- Card corner radius: 26–32 px. Internal padding: 24–32 px. Gap between title and body: 12–18 px.

Micro-interactions & animations:
- Card entrance: subtle upward slide with fade-in (duration 420ms, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)).
- Slider knob: smooth easing when moved (200–300ms, ease-out). Milestone highlight pulse (180ms) when reached.
- CTA: ripple effect or scale on tap (150ms, ease-in-out).

Accessibility notes: use 4.5:1 contrast for CTA text; increase label sizes on smaller screens; allow alternative text for illustrated characters.
content.layout:
Overall layout: single-column vertical flow with two major stacked cards (hero challenge card on top, large support card below). Each card uses heavy corner radius and internal horizontal padding. The view is vertically scrollable.

Structure breakdown:
- Screen container: 1 column full width (safe area width minus side margins ~16–20 px).
- Row 1 (Hero card): one group — full-width rounded rectangle with left-aligned title and right-aligned illustration. Internally it is a two-column arrangement: text column (approx 60% width) and illustration column (approx 40% width) but visually the text dominates left side.
- Vertical gap between cards: ~28–36 px.
- Row 2 (Support card): main card is visually divided into 2 columns inside the card:
  - Left column (content group) — occupies ~62–68% of card width; contains heading, body text, radio options (two rows), price pill, slider with milestones, CTA button, and small dismiss label.
  - Right column (illustration group) — narrow column (~32–38% width) containing the tall Okapi/deer illustration cropped to card height.
- Within the left column, stacked groups (rows) in order: heading (row), body paragraph (row), radio choices (two stacked rows), price pill (row), slider (row), CTA (row), dismiss (row).
- Slider row has a single horizontal track with 5 equidistant step circles forming a 1-row grid; knob is circular and slightly larger than step markers.

Grid & alignment:
- The interior uses a single-column vertical rhythm for content inside left column, with consistent vertical spacing (~12–18 px between elements). 
- Horizontal alignment: left column text aligned to the card left padding; right column illustration flush to the card's right inner edge and visually overlaps.

Counts & groups:
- Columns: 1 main column overall, inside support card 2 columns (text + illustration). 
- Rows: two major rows (hero, support). Within support card left column there are 7 stacked rows of content.
- Slider grid: 1 row with 5 columns (milestones).
content.functions:
Low-level actions the user can take on this screen:
- Tap the top-right rounded action button to open additional menu or settings (visual: gradient circular button with wave icon). 
- Observe progress indicator at top-left (small circle with blue arc and numeral) — tap to view progress or challenge details. 
- Read the hero card to learn about the current 10-day challenge (static content). 
- Scroll vertically to view lower content (main card scrolls inside the screen). 
- Read the "Become a Supporter" heading and descriptive paragraph (informational). 
- Choose between subscription frequency options by tapping the radio buttons (ONE-TIME or MONTHLY). The radio state updates visually with a filled teal circle and check icon for selected option. 
- Tap or drag the slider knob (donut thumbnail) to adjust support level / reward tier; as the knob moves the price pill updates to reflect the selected amount. 
- Tap the price pill for a detailed pricing breakdown or to edit currency (possible secondary action). 
- Tap the primary CTA button "Get donuts for creators!" to start the payment/donation flow — this triggers the transaction modal or in-app purchase flow. 
- Tap the small "DISMISS" text to close/dismiss the promo card.

Medium-level tasks / workflows:
- Select support frequency and amount then confirm donation/one-time payment via CTA. The UI provides immediate visual confirmation of selected amount and frequency before checkout. 
- Use the slider with milestones to select reward tiers; each milestone corresponds to a different creator reward (thumbnail indicates tier). 
- Quickly learn what supporting does (read elevator pitch) and decide whether to support now or dismiss.

High-level goals achieved via this screen:
- Convert users into supporters/donors by offering a quick, friction-light payment flow (one-time or recurring). 
- Communicate value (unlock a unique character) visually and with concise copy to motivate support. 
- Provide clear call-to-action and easy adjustment of payment amount and cadence so users can support at their preferred level. 

How UI supports these goals:
- Strong visual hierarchy (teal heading, muted body) guides eyes from offer to controls to CTA. 
- Interactive slider + thumbnail gives tangible, gamified feedback for choosing donation tiers. 
- Single prominent CTA reduces friction and clarifies the next step. 
- Radios present clear frequency choices, and the dismiss option lets users decline without leaving the current context.

content.description:
Overall style: playful, colorful mobile-first design with large rounded cards, friendly vector illustrations and soft shadows. Visual language mixes bold saturated accent colors with light airy pastels; typography is a rounded humanist sans with strong weight contrast between headings and body copy. Layout is vertically stacked content with a large rounded promotional card at top and an expanded bottom sheet-style support/donation card beneath it.

Card & container styles:

Right side features a cropped vector illustration (deer) overlapping the card edge.

The active knob is a white circular handle (diameter ~52 px) with soft shadow and an inner thumbnail (pie icon). Above the knob a rounded price bubble shows the selected amount (example bubble background white, text cyan #08BBE7, text weight 700). The slider track and nodes are centered horizontally in the card and spaced evenly.

Button has a subtle top gradient or flat fill, and a soft drop shadow for elevation. On press it reduces elevation and slightly scales down (micro interaction).

Icons & imagery:

- Small circular progress / level indicator in upper-left corner of the screen (brown circle with a cyan arc) used as a gamification indicator.
- Top-right rounded floating button (pink gradient with a wavy icon) — small circular control with subtle gloss.

Spacing & alignment:

- Vertical spacing between stacked cards ~18–26 px.

content.description:
Overall visual style
- Playful, friendly mobile-first design using large rounded cards, flat vector illustrations, and high-contrast CTAs. The look is modern, rounded and bubbly with generous whitespace and soft drop shadows. Visual hierarchy is established with large condensed headlines, medium-weight body text in muted grey, and a bold cyan CTA.

Color palette (approximate hex values used in screen)
- Primary cyan (CTA / accents): #07BBE7 (provided)
- Accent yellow (top hero): #E2BE0C (provided)
- Deep navy (rare accents / small status): #24278B (provided)
- Deep red accent (very small accents): #8F2524 (provided)
- Dark grey / background stroke: #302834 (provided)
- Card background (light blue): #E6FBFF (very pale aqua; approximate #E8FBFD)
- Body text color: #7A8B92 (neutral muted slate grey)
- Strong heading color: #00A6CC (darker cyan for heading) or white on dark backgrounds
- Price pill text: #07BBE7 on white
- Disabled/dismiss text: #D7E8EB (very light grey)

Layout & structure
- Overall device frame: standard narrow mobile (iPhone 375pt width approx). Content is single-column vertical scroll.
- Top of screen: partially visible hero card (rounded rectangle, mustard/yellow background #E2BE0C) with headline text “Drop Beer Deer” (large bold white text, left-aligned) and an illustration of a deer on the right, cropped by the card’s right edge.
- Main interactive element: large bottom sheet-style rounded card anchored from roughly 20% from the top down to the bottom of the screen (it occupies ~70–80% of screen height). Card background is a very pale aqua (#E6FBFF) with a thin cyan-tinted stroke border (1–2 px, rgba(7,187,231,0.12)). Outer corner radius ~28–32 px.
- Inside the bottom card: two visual columns (left text/controls column ~60–65% width, right illustration column ~35–40% width). The right column contains a tall character illustration (Okapi / deer-like) that is vertically cropped and overlaps the card edge — positioned in the top-right corner and clipped so only the animal torso/head/leg show.
- Top-left inside the card: small uppercase micro-label “Become a Supporter” header block — H1 style headline in bold rounded sans (approx. 22–26 px, weight 700), color #00A6CC (slightly darker cyan). Below the headline is a 3–4 line description paragraph in neutral grey (#7A8B92), regular weight (14–16 px, line-height 20–22 px). Copy is left-aligned and constrained to the left column width.

Controls & interactive elements
- Donation frequency radio options: stacked vertical radio controls. First option is a selected circular radio with a cyan filled circle and a white check icon inside (circle diameter ~28 px). Label “ONE-TIME” to the right in bold cyan uppercase (12–13 px, weight 700). The second option below is an unselected circle (light grey border / filled #F0F4F5) with label “MONTHLY” in muted grey (12–13 px). Spacing between radio rows ~12–16 px.
- Price pill: a small rounded pill with white background and cyan text “1,99€” (approx. 36–42 px wide, 28 px height, pill radius 18 px). Text inside is bold 16–18 px.
- Reward icon: to the left of the slider there is a circular badge (48 px) containing a candy illustration (multicolored). Circle has a subtle white/very pale drop shadow and sits aligned with the slider baseline.
- Progress / amount selector: a horizontal bar with 4 equidistant circular nodes (dots). The track is a thin rounded stroke of pale cyan (#CFF6FB) ~6 px height. Each step dot is a small circle with a white inner dot and pale cyan stroke; selected node is filled cyan. Spacing: track width ~65–70% of left column width; node diameter ~18 px; node-to-node spacing ~32–36 px.
- Primary CTA: a large full-bleed rounded button spanning most of the left column width or entire card width minus card padding. Button background is the primary cyan #07BBE7, height ~56 px, border-radius ~28 px, centered label “Get candy for creators!” in white, bold 18–20 px. Button has a subtle shadow (rgba(7,187,231,0.18), 0 6px 14px) to lift it.
- Dismiss row: below the CTA is faint “DISMISS” text in uppercase, pale grey (#D7E8EB), center aligned to indicate a secondary action. This likely functions as a non-primary close link.

Typography
- Headline (card header): Rounded sans (examples: Poppins, Nunito, or Avenir Next Rounded) — weight 700, size 22–26 px, letter-spacing 0.2–0.4 px.
- Main CTA: same rounded font, weight 700, 18–20 px.
- Body paragraph: Regular weight 14–16 px, line-height 20–22 px, color #7A8B92.
- Radio labels: uppercase 12–13 px, small caps feel, weight 700 for selected, 600/500 for unselected.

Spacing & metrics (approx. for 375 px wide screen)
- Card side margins: 16–20 px left/right. Top margin between stacked cards: ~18–24 px.
- Inside card padding: 20–24 px left/right, 22–28 px top, 20–28 px bottom.
- Illustration width: right column ~130–150 px, clipped; the visual overlaps card edge slightly to feel playful.
- CTA margin-top: ~22–28 px above CTA.

Icons & imagery
- All illustrations are flat vector, high-contrast with playful details (sunglasses, printed clothes, chain with letters). Use saturated colors but remain on pale backgrounds so text is legible. The candy icon is a small vector inside a circular badge.

States & micro-interactions
- Radio toggle: 180–220ms scale/opacity transition when toggled; check icon fades in and circle fills with cyan.
- Slider nodes: when changing value, the selected node grows by 10% and a small scale easing animation over 200–300ms occurs. Track fill from left to current node animates with ease-out curve (cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.25,1)).
- CTA press: quick 100–150ms scale to 0.98 and shadow reduces.

Accessibility
- Headline contrast on yellow hero uses white text; ensure sufficient contrast or add text-shadow. Text sizes are large enough for mobile, and interactive targets are >=44 px.

Z-index & layering
- Hero card at top is behind the bottom sheet (z-index lower) — you can see the hero partially blurred/dimmed behind the floating top elements.
- Floating circular controls in top-left and top-right overlap hero and bottom sheet (small round buttons with icons), acting as persistent shortcuts.

Recreation notes
- Use a single-column layout at 375px width. Create two stacked rounded cards: top narrow hero rectangle (height ~110 px) with mustard yellow bg and right-side deer illustration; below it the bottom sheet card (rounded 28 px, pale aqua) with left text/controls and right clipped illustration. Include radio rows, price pill, horizontal node-style slider, large cyan CTA and a small dismiss link beneath. Add two small floating round buttons in the top corners for context. Match typography choices with rounded sans font and the color palette above.

The left column uses a vertical stack: headline -> paragraph -> radio block -> price + slider row -> CTA -> dismiss. Spacing is consistent with 16–24 px vertical gaps.

Grids and alignment

Keywords to describe layout: number of columns/groups
- Outer: single-column mobile stack
- Inner (supporter card): two-column split (text controls / illustration)
- Visual groups: 3 grouped areas inside card (info block, control block, action block)

content.functions:
Specific (micro) actions users can take on this screen
- Read the headline and descriptive paragraph explaining the support option (text selection and visual scanning).
- Select donation frequency by tapping a radio option (ONE-TIME selected by default; tap MONTHLY to switch). Selected radio shows a filled cyan circle with a white check icon; unselected displays a grey circle.
- View and tap the price pill to review the amount (the pill is a visual indicator; tapping might reveal an amount input or confirm selection). 
- Adjust donation amount or tier by tapping nodes on the horizontal stepper/slider. Each node represents discrete price tiers; tapping a node updates the price pill and shows the progress fill along the track.
- Tap the primary CTA (“Get candy for creators!”) to initiate the purchase/checkout flow to complete payment and unlock the promised reward (unique character). The CTA gives immediate visual feedback on press and transitions to a payment/confirmation flow.
- Dismiss the modal by tapping the faint “DISMISS” link at the bottom or by using a system back gesture; floating buttons in the top corners may navigate elsewhere or open other controls.

Medium-level tasks / workflows
- Choose whether to support once or subscribe monthly, pick an amount tier, view the reward associated with that tier, and confirm the transaction. The UI provides instant visual confirmation of the selected options (radio state, price pill, slider node highlight) before you proceed.
- Preview the unlocked reward (illustrated character) while deciding on the donation amount, giving users a clear incentive to convert.
- Quickly leave or ignore the offer with the Dismiss action, preserving context behind the bottom sheet.

Broader goal
- The overarching purpose of this interface is to convert engaged users into paying supporters: to collect a one-time donation or a recurring subscription that supports creators and unlocks an in-app reward. The screen reduces friction by keeping choices minimal (two frequencies, a small set of tiers), offering a clear reward preview, and providing a single bold CTA for fast conversion. Visual cues (color, illustration, and large CTA) guide users to the intended action while still allowing an easy out.
